fact: The carbon in a rock remembers the life that made it.

name: Geochemical cycle
fact: Every atom in the crust is somewhere on a long round trip.

name: Goldschmidt classification
fact: Some elements follow the iron, some the sulfur, some the rock.

name: Igneous differentiation
fact: One melt can give rise to many different rocks.

name: Isotope geochemistry
fact: Small differences in weight tell you where something came from.

name: Primordial nuclide
fact: Atoms older than the planet they sit in.

name: Natural hydrogen
fact: Rock and water make it underground, and people have begun drilling for it.

name: Trace element
fact: Present in tiny amounts, and often decisive.

name: Earth's internal heat budget
fact: Half of it is radioactive decay, half is heat left over from the beginning.

name: Geodynamics
fact: The physics of a planet slowly stirring itself.

name: Geophysical fluid dynamics
fact: Fluids on a spinning planet behave very oddly.

name: Gravimetry
fact: Measuring gravity precisely shows you what is buried below.

name: Gravity of Earth
fact: Slightly weaker at the equator, where the spin works against it.

name: Near surface geophysics
fact: Seeing a few metres into the ground without digging.

name: Geomagnetic pole
fact: An idealised pole, not the one your compass actually points at.

name: Magnetic anomaly
fact: Stripes of them on the sea floor proved sea-floor spreading.

name: North magnetic pole
fact: It wanders, and lately it has been moving quickly.

name: South magnetic pole
fact: It is not opposite the northern one, because the field is not tidy.

name: Geomagnetic storm
fact: It brings aurorae, and it can knock out power grids.

name: Seismic wave
fact: These waves are how we know the Earth has a core.

name: Shear wave
fact: They cannot cross liquid, which is how the outer core was found.

name: Seismic intensity scales
fact: They measure what the shaking did, not what the fault released.

name: Seismic magnitude scales
fact: One number for the whole event, however far away you are.

name: Seismic refraction
fact: Thump the ground, time the echo, and read the layers.

name: Shadow zone
fact: The gap in the records is the shape of the liquid core.

name: Elastic rebound theory
fact: The rock bends for centuries, then snaps back in seconds.

name: Earthquake preparedness
fact: Water, a torch, and furniture bolted to the wall.

name: Earthquake early warning system
fact: The warning outruns the shaking, because radio is faster than rock.

name: Earthquake prediction
fact: Nobody can do it yet, and many doubt anyone ever will.

name: Mainshock
fact: Which one it was is sometimes only clear afterwards.

name: Foreshock
fact: Only hindsight tells you a quake was a foreshock.

name: Epicenter
fact: The quake itself happens underneath, often far below.

name: Focal mechanism
fact: Drawn as a beach ball, it shows which way the fault moved.

name: Slow earthquake
fact: A fault slipping quietly, felt by instruments and nobody else.

name: Interplate earthquake
fact: More than nine in ten of the world's quakes are these.

name: Deep focus earthquake
fact: Rock that deep should flow rather than break, which is still a puzzle.

name: Historical geology
fact: Reading the planet's past out of its rocks.

name: Age of Earth
fact: Settled by lead isotopes in a meteorite, not in a rock of Earth.

name: Potassium argon dating
fact: It dated the ash beds around the earliest human fossils.

name: Rubidium strontium dating
fact: Good for very old rocks, because the decay is very slow.

name: Monazite geochronology
fact: A single grain can record several mountain-building events.

name: Thermochronology
fact: It dates not when a rock formed, but when it cooled on the way up.

name: Paleoclimatology
fact: Ice, shells and tree rings stand in for thermometers.

name: Geological history of oxygen
fact: Free oxygen in the air is a late and biological arrival.

name: Paleotempestology
fact: Storm surges leave sand in coastal ponds, centuries deep.

name: Paleothermometer
fact: Shells record the sea temperature they grew in.

name: Huronian glaciation
fact: It followed the first rise of oxygen, which stripped the air of methane.

name: Marinoan glaciation
fact: One of the snowball Earth episodes, with ice reaching the tropics.

name: Hirnantian glaciation
fact: It came with one of the great mass extinctions.

name: Late Paleozoic icehouse
fact: The coal forests grew while the southern continents lay under ice.

name: Last Glacial Maximum
fact: Sea level was so low that Britain was part of the continent.

name: Late Pleistocene extinctions
fact: Mammoths, giant sloths and much else went, as people spread.

name: Palaeogeography
fact: Mapping coastlines that have not existed for millions of years.

name: Paleo Tethys Ocean
fact: It closed as the continents gathered into Pangaea.

name: Paleocontinent
fact: Laurentia, Baltica, Gondwana: the pieces our continents were cut from.

name: Eoarchean
fact: The oldest rocks we have date from it, and little else survives.

name: Paleoarchean
fact: The oldest convincing traces of life come from these rocks.

name: Neoarchean
fact: The continents were largely assembled by its end.

name: Mesoproterozoic
fact: Sometimes called the boring billion, because so little changed.

name: Neoproterozoic
fact: It ends with snowball Earths and the first animals.

name: Andean orogeny
fact: An ocean plate diving under a continent, still building mountains today.

name: Cretaceous Paleogene boundary
fact: That iridium is why we know an asteroid struck.

name: Geology of the Appalachians
fact: Worn-down stumps of a range that was once as high as the Alps.

name: Geology of the Himalayas
fact: India is still driving north, and the range is still rising.

name: Hawaii hotspot
fact: The plate moves over it, so the islands come out in a line.

name: Laramide orogeny
fact: It raised the Rockies far inland from any plate margin.

name: Acasta Gneiss
fact: Among the oldest intact rock known on the planet.

name: Yellowstone hotspot
fact: The geysers sit on the roof of a very large magma chamber.

name: Earth pigment
fact: The ochres of the cave paintings are iron-stained clay.

name: Mineral physics
fact: Squeezing minerals in the laboratory to learn what the mantle is doing.

name: Arsenate mineral
fact: Often brilliantly coloured, and best not handled casually.

name: Borate mineral
fact: Borax, the laundry mineral, is the familiar one.

name: Halide mineral
fact: Rock salt and fluorite belong here.

name: Native element mineral
fact: Gold, copper, sulfur and diamond, each uncombined.

name: Native metal
fact: Only a few metals are ever found this way, which is why they were used first.

name: Telluric iron
fact: Extremely rare, because free oxygen rusts it away.

name: Oxide mineral
fact: Most of the world's iron and titanium ores are oxides.

name: Brookite
fact: Same recipe as rutile, different packing.

name: Spinel group
fact: One structure that will take almost any pair of metals.

name: Coltan
fact: It is in every phone, and its trade has funded wars.

name: Thorianite
fact: It was first mistaken for uraninite, which it closely resembles.

name: Silicate mineral
fact: Nine tenths of the crust is made of them.

name: Aluminosilicate
fact: Clays, feldspars and zeolites are all built this way.

name: Amphibole
fact: The double chain holds water in its structure, which matters when the rock melts.

name: Diopside
fact: A common mineral of the mantle, sometimes cut as a green gem.

name: Hedenbergite
fact: It is almost never found pure in nature.

name: Pigeonite
fact: Common in lavas that cooled too fast for the crystals to sort themselves out.

name: Chlorite group
fact: Despite the name they contain no chlorine.

name: Clay mineral
fact: Flat sheets, which is why wet clay slides and holds its shape.

name: Vermiculite
fact: Heat it and the trapped water puffs it up like popcorn.

name: Plagioclase
fact: One mineral that changes steadily from sodium-rich to calcium-rich.

name: Phosphate mineral
fact: Bone and tooth enamel are made of one of them.

name: Sulfate mineral
fact: Gypsum, the plaster mineral, is the commonest.

name: Bowen's reaction series
fact: It explains why one melt gives basalt and granite in turn.

name: Porosity
fact: It decides whether a rock can hold water or oil.

name: Iron ore
fact: Most of it was laid down when the oceans first rusted.

name: Extrusive rock
fact: Cooled fast, so the crystals are too small to see.

name: Igneous intrusion
fact: Magma that never made it out, and froze on the way.

name: Intrusive rock
fact: Slow cooling gives the big crystals you see in granite.

name: Greisen
fact: Its own hot fluids rework it, and tin often comes with it.

name: Porphyry copper deposit
fact: Low grade, enormous, and the source of most of the world's copper.

name: Volcanic rock
fact: Basalt is the commonest rock on the surface of the Earth.

name: Serpentinization
fact: It gives off hydrogen, which may be why some vents support life.

name: Blueschist
fact: It only forms where a slab is driven down fast enough to stay cold.

name: Tectonite
fact: The rock keeps a record of how it was pushed.

name: Cataclasite
fact: Ground up by the fault, then welded back together.

name: Ironstone
fact: It gave the early iron industries their raw material.

name: Geologist
fact: The hammer is the badge, though most of the work is reading.

name: Earth's rotation
fact: It is gradually slowing, and the day grows longer.

name: Foucault pendulum
fact: The swing holds still while the floor turns under it.

name: Figure of the Earth
fact: Which shape you use depends on how exact you need to be.

name: Equatorial bulge
fact: The Earth is about twenty kilometres fatter than it is tall.

name: Flat Earth
fact: Educated opinion abandoned it long before Columbus sailed.

name: Spherical Earth
fact: The Greeks measured its size from shadows in two towns.

name: Gaia hypothesis
fact: Life keeps the air and the sea fit for life.

name: Early Earth
fact: Molten, airless, and hit constantly.

name: Milankovitch cycles
fact: Small wobbles in the orbit pace the ice ages.

name: Calcium cycle
fact: Rock weathers, shells grow, and the sea floor turns back into limestone.

name: Oxygen cycle
fact: Nearly all the free oxygen we breathe passes through living things.

name: Phosphorus cycle
fact: It has no gas phase, so it moves slowly and runs short.

name: Carbon sequestration
fact: Forests, soils and the deep sea all hold it, for very different lengths of time.

name: Geologic record
fact: The pages are many, but a great number have been torn out.

name: Geological hazard
fact: Quakes, slides and eruptions are hazards only where people live.

name: Forensic geophysics
fact: Finding what is buried without disturbing it.

name: Geomathematics
fact: The Earth is sampled unevenly, and the mathematics has to cope.

name: Remineralisation
fact: Bacteria give the nutrients back, mostly before they reach the sea floor.

name: Radium and radon in the environment
fact: Radon seeps from the ground into houses, and is a leading cause of lung cancer.

name: Atmospheric chemistry
fact: It explains both the ozone hole and smog.

name: Atmospheric escape
fact: It is why Mars is thin-aired and the Earth is not.

name: Earth's energy budget
fact: When the two stop matching, the planet warms or cools.

name: Outgoing longwave radiation
fact: The planet's only way of losing heat.

name: Radiative forcing
fact: One number for how hard something pushes the climate.

name: Solar irradiance
fact: It varies only slightly, which is why the Sun is not the current culprit.

name: Ice albedo feedback
fact: Less ice means more sunlight absorbed, which means less ice.

name: Climate sensitivity
fact: The single most consequential number in the subject.

name: Climate model
fact: The planet is cut into boxes and the physics run forward.

name: Climate system
fact: Air, water, ice, land and life, all pulling on each other.

name: Microclimate
fact: A south wall, a hollow or a city street each has its own.

name: Alpine climate
fact: Going up a mountain is like travelling towards the pole.

name: Continental climate
fact: Far from the sea, nothing evens out the seasons.

name: Humid subtropical climate
fact: Hot and sticky in summer, and rarely frozen.

name: Polar climate
fact: No month averages above ten degrees.

name: Semi arid climate
fact: Dry enough for grass, too dry for forest.

name: Subarctic climate
fact: It is the climate of the great northern conifer forests.

name: Mediterranean climate
fact: The olive, the vine and the cork oak all follow it.

name: Tropical monsoon climate
fact: The year is divided into the wet and the dry, not into four.

name: Tropical rainforest climate
fact: No dry season at all, and barely any seasons.

name: Tropical savanna climate
fact: Grass with scattered trees, because the dry season stops a forest closing.

name: Greenhouse gas
fact: Without any at all the Earth would be frozen over.

name: Ocean acidification
fact: The sea absorbs our carbon dioxide, and shells pay for it.

name: Extreme weather
fact: Rare by definition, and becoming less so.

name: Global dimming
fact: Our own pollution has been masking part of the warming.

name: Arctic sea ice decline
fact: It now melts more each summer than it makes back each winter.

name: Drylands
fact: Two fifths of the land, and a great many of the people.

name: Desertification
fact: It is less the desert advancing than the land giving way.

name: Deserts and xeric shrublands
fact: Life here is built around getting water and keeping it.

name: Chaparral
fact: It is shaped by fire, and many of its seeds need fire to open.

name: Heath
fact: Much of it was made by people clearing woodland and grazing.

name: Mediterranean forests woodlands and scrub
fact: Five small regions of the world, and an extraordinary number of plant species.

name: Moorland
fact: Peat beneath, heather above, and wind over the top.

name: Montane ecosystem
fact: Climb a mountain and you pass through several biomes.

name: Alpine tundra
fact: Above the tree line, and nothing grows tall.

name: Tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests
fact: They hold more kinds of living thing than any other land biome.

name: Temperate rainforest
fact: Cool, dripping and hung with moss.

name: Temperate coniferous forest
fact: The tall needle forests of the mild coasts.

name: Temperate deciduous forest
fact: Dropping the leaves is cheaper than defending them through the frost.

name: Tropical forest
fact: Warm all year, so growth never stops.

name: Seasonal tropical forest
fact: The trees drop their leaves for the dry months, not for winter.

name: Tropical and subtropical dry broadleaf forests
fact: Warm all year, but thirsty for half of it.

name: Tropical and subtropical coniferous forests
fact: Pines in the tropics, usually where the soil is poor.

name: Woodland
fact: Open enough for sunlight and grass between the trees.

name: Grove in nature
fact: Trees enough to stand in, not enough to get lost in.

name: Montane grasslands and shrublands
fact: The paramo and the high steppe belong here.

name: Temperate grasslands savannas and shrublands
fact: Prairie, pampas and steppe, and almost all of it now ploughed.

name: Tropical and subtropical grasslands savannas and shrublands
fact: Fire and grazing keep the trees from closing over.

name: Fen
fact: Fed from below, unlike a bog, which drinks only rain.

name: Flooded grasslands and savannas
fact: Seasonal flooding makes them extraordinary for birds.

name: Peatland
fact: Waterlogged, so the dead plants never fully rot, and the carbon stays put.

name: Riparian zone
fact: A narrow strip that does a great deal of work for the water.

name: Aquatic ecosystem
fact: Fresh or salt, it is the larger share of the planet.

name: Deep sea community
fact: Cold, dark and under great pressure, and still crowded with life.

name: Neuston
fact: They live on the skin of the water, above and below it.

name: Marine ecosystem
fact: Most of the living space on the planet is in here.

name: Marine coastal ecosystem
fact: A thin band that carries much of the sea's productivity.

name: Ocean surface ecosystem
fact: A floating habitat with no floor at all.

name: Sea surface microlayer
fact: A film thinner than a hair, through which everything must pass.

name: Marine habitat
fact: From a tide pool to a trench, all of it is one word.

name: Littoral zone
fact: Covered and uncovered twice a day, and nothing there minds.

name: Mangrove forest
fact: Trees that stand in salt water and breathe through their roots.

name: Neritic zone
fact: Sunlit all the way down, which is why the fishing is here.

name: Seagrass meadow
fact: Real flowering plants, not seaweed, and they went back to the sea.

name: Freshwater ecosystem
fact: A tiny share of the water, and a large share of the species.

name: Lake ecosystem
fact: It sorts itself into layers, and turns over with the seasons.

name: River ecosystem
fact: Everything in it has to deal with the current.

name: Landscape
fact: Part geology, part history, and part the eye of the beholder.

name: Wilderness
fact: Less of it survives than most people suppose.

name: Land use
fact: How we divide the surface is as consequential as the climate.

name: Planetary boundaries
fact: Nine limits, several of which are already crossed.

name: Human impact on the environment
fact: We now move more rock and soil each year than the rivers do.

name: Environmental degradation
fact: Rarely one decision, usually a thousand small ones.

name: Environmental protection
fact: Clean air laws have saved more lives than most medicines.

name: Environmental science
fact: It has to borrow from every science at once.

name: Environmental studies
fact: It takes in the law and the economics as well as the ecology.

name: Environmental policy
fact: The hard part is making the polluter pay the cost.

name: Environmental resource management
fact: Deciding who gets the water, the timber and the fish.

name: Overexploitation
fact: Take faster than it grows back and the stock collapses.

name: Overfishing
fact: The Grand Banks cod never came back.

name: Environmental issues
fact: Air, water, soil, and the living things that depend on all three.

name: Environmental justice
fact: The dump and the smelter are rarely built in the rich part of town.

name: Tragedy of the commons
fact: Real commons were often managed well, by rules the herders made themselves.

name: Human and wildlife conflict
fact: Elephants in a field are a conservation problem and a livelihood problem at once.

name: Disaster response
fact: The first rescuers are almost always the neighbours.

name: Weather station
fact: A long unbroken record is worth more than a precise one.

name: Surface weather observation
fact: Taken on the hour, the world over, in the same way.

name: Surface weather analysis
fact: The familiar chart of fronts, highs and lows.

name: Marine weather forecasting
fact: At sea the forecast is a safety matter, not a convenience.

name: Indian summer
fact: A few borrowed days after the first frost.

name: Cumulus humilis cloud
fact: Wider than they are tall, and they promise nothing.

name: Cumulus mediocris cloud
fact: About as tall as it is wide, and still deciding what to become.

name: Fractus cloud
fact: Torn-off scraps, racing under the storm.

name: Altostratus undulatus cloud
fact: Wind shear ripples the sheet like sand under water.

name: Rain and snow mixed
fact: It falls when the air just above you is a degree too warm.

name: Zonal and meridional flow
fact: When the jet stream buckles, the weather stops moving on.

name: Winter storm
fact: The wind is usually what does the damage.

name: Atmospheric electricity
fact: There is a steady current flowing between the ground and the sky at all times.

name: Lightning strike
fact: The flash goes up as well as down, faster than the eye can follow.

name: Sprite lightning
fact: Photographed only recently, though pilots had reported them for years.

name: Atlantic hurricane
fact: It needs warm water, and it dies over land.

name: Tropical cyclogenesis
fact: Warm sea, moist air, a spin, and little wind shear.

name: Tropical cyclone forecasting
fact: Track forecasts have improved greatly; strength forecasts far less.

name: Tropical cyclone preparedness
fact: Most deaths come from the water, not the wind.

name: Prevailing winds
fact: The trade winds carried the sailing routes of the world.

name: Vertical draft
fact: The up-draught builds the storm and the down-draught kills it.

name: Climate change feedbacks
fact: Some damp the warming, and the strongest of them amplify it.

name: Arctic methane emissions
fact: Thawing ground may release gas that has been locked up for ages.

name: Tipping points in the climate system
fact: Past the point, stopping the push does not undo the change.

name: Climate change mitigation
fact: Cutting emissions, and taking carbon back out.

name: Climate change vulnerability
fact: The least responsible places are often the most exposed.

name: Deforestation and climate change
fact: Cut the forest and you release its carbon and lose its rain.

name: Deforestation of the Amazon rainforest
fact: Most of the cleared land becomes cattle pasture.

name: Effects of climate change
fact: Heat, rising seas, fiercer rain and longer droughts, all at once.

name: Effects of climate change on agriculture
fact: Some northern land improves, but more of the farmed land gets worse.

name: Effects of climate change on human health
fact: Heat kills quietly, and mostly the old.

name: Effects of climate change on oceans
fact: The sea has absorbed most of the extra heat so far.

name: Effects of climate change on small island countries
fact: For some of them it is a question of whether the country remains.

name: Greenhouse gas emissions
fact: Power, industry, transport and farming, roughly in that order.

name: Carbon budget
fact: How much more can be burned before a given warming is locked in.

name: Methane emissions
fact: It is short-lived but powerful, so cutting it works fast.

name: Politics of climate change
fact: The costs fall now and the benefits fall later, which is politically hard.

name: Climate change denial
fact: Much of the organised doubt was paid for by the fuel industry.

name: Solar activity and climate
fact: It cannot explain the present warming, because the Sun has not brightened.

name: Economic analysis of climate change
fact: Everything turns on how you value people not yet born.

name: East Asian monsoon
fact: It waters the rice of a third of the world's people.

name: Monsoon of South Asia
fact: The whole farming year waits on its arrival.

name: Harmattan
fact: It carries Saharan dust as far as the Americas.

name: Atlantic hurricane season
fact: It runs from early June to the end of November.

name: Climate change in Africa
fact: It has contributed least to the cause and stands to suffer most.

name: Climate change in Antarctica
fact: What happens to its ice sheets sets the sea level for everyone.

name: Climate change in Australia
fact: Fire seasons have lengthened at both ends.

name: Climate change in Brazil
fact: The Amazon is both a victim of it and a lever on it.

name: Climate change in Canada
fact: The north is warming at several times the global rate.

name: Climate change in Europe
fact: It is the fastest-warming continent.

name: Climate change in India
fact: Heat and the monsoon together decide the harvest.

name: Climate change in Indonesia
fact: A country of islands has a great deal of coast to lose.

name: Climate change in Japan
fact: Hotter summers, and heavier rain when the typhoons come.

name: Conflict minerals law
fact: Tin, tungsten, tantalum and gold, traced back along the supply chain.

name: Carbonate rock
fact: Limestone and dolomite, and most of it was once alive.

name: Clastic rock
fact: Old rock, broken up, carried off and set down again.

name: Nodule in geology
fact: Flint in chalk is the familiar one.

name: Cementation in geology
fact: It is what turns loose sand into sandstone.

name: Degradation in geology
fact: The river cuts down instead of filling up.

name: Grain size
fact: From boulder to clay, the scale is the first thing a geologist records.

name: Loam
fact: The mixture gardeners want, because it holds water without waterlogging.

name: Pelagic sediment
fact: Mostly the shells of plankton, falling for a thousand years.

name: Siliceous ooze
fact: Made of the glassy skeletons of diatoms and radiolarians.

name: Roundness in geology
fact: How round a pebble is tells you how far it has travelled.

name: Bed load
fact: The grains that roll and bounce rather than float.

name: Dissolved load
fact: The part of the river you cannot see, and the part that salts the sea.

name: Sediment gravity flow
fact: The sediment pulls the water along, not the other way round.

name: Suspended load
fact: It is what makes a river brown after rain.

name: Sedimentary structures
fact: Ripples and cross-bedding record the current that made them.

name: Bedform
fact: Ripples and dunes, in a river or in a desert.

name: Soft sediment deformation structures
fact: Often the fossil record of an ancient earthquake.

name: Edaphology
fact: Soil science seen from the plant's point of view.

name: Pedology
fact: Soil as a body in its own right, with layers and a history.

name: Leaching in pedology
fact: Rain washes the goodness downward, out of reach of roots.

name: Plant litter
fact: The forest feeds itself with what it drops.

name: Soil chemistry
fact: Whether a plant can get at a nutrient is a chemical question.

name: Soil acidity
fact: It decides which nutrients dissolve and which lock away.

name: Soil classification
fact: Every country has had its own scheme, and reconciling them is hard.

name: Soil texture
fact: You can judge it by rubbing a wet pinch between your fingers.

name: Soil type
fact: Soils are named and mapped as carefully as rocks.

name: Soil health
fact: A spade of healthy soil holds more living things than there are people.

name: Soil morphology
fact: Dig a pit, and the layers tell you the soil's whole story.

name: Soil physics
fact: How water moves through it governs almost everything else.

name: Biostratigraphy
fact: The right fossil dates a layer better than any rock can.

name: Chronostratigraphy
fact: It builds the single timescale that all geologists share.

name: Lithostratigraphy
fact: Layers named and traced by what they are made of.

name: Magnetostratigraphy
fact: The Earth's reversals are written into the rock as a barcode.

name: Sequence stratigraphy
fact: It was developed for finding oil, and reshaped the whole field.

name: Basement in geology
fact: Everything else is a blanket laid over it.

name: Biozone
fact: A slice of rock defined by what lived then.

name: Contact in geology
fact: Reading a contact tells you which rock came first.

name: Facies
fact: Same age, different world: reef here, mud there.

name: Greenstone belt
fact: They carry a great deal of the world's gold.

name: Marine regression
fact: The sea pulls back and leaves its floor as dry land.

name: Marine transgression
fact: Chalk downs were laid down when the sea came in like this.

name: Past sea level
fact: It has stood both far above and far below today's shore.

name: Stratigraphic section
fact: Measured bed by bed, from the bottom up.

name: Stratigraphic unit
fact: A formation is the working unit of the geological map.

name: Diapir
fact: Buried salt is lighter than rock, so it rises in domes.

name: Crenulation
fact: A fold folded again, on the scale of a fingernail.

name: Lineation in geology
fact: Minerals comb themselves into lines that point the way the rock moved.

name: Detachment fault
fact: Whole mountain ranges have slid along one of these.

name: Shear zone
fact: Where it is too hot to break, rock smears instead.

name: Slickenside
fact: The scratches show which way the fault last moved.

name: Structural basin
fact: The strata dip inward from every side.

name: Continental margin
fact: The real edge of a continent lies well out to sea.

name: Continental rise
fact: A long apron of mud at the foot of the slope.

name: Slab in geology
fact: Some of them can still be imaged lying at the bottom of the mantle.

name: Back arc basin
fact: The plate behind the arc is pulled open as the slab rolls back.

name: Forearc
fact: It collects the scrapings off the descending plate.

name: Foreland basin
fact: The range is so heavy that the crust sags beside it.

name: Pull apart basin
fact: The Dead Sea sits in one.

name: Geologic province
fact: A way of carving the crust into regions that share a history.

name: Amur plate
fact: Its slow movement is felt in Japanese and Korean earthquakes.

name: Okhotsk plate
fact: The great Tohoku earthquake happened on its edge.

name: Somali plate
fact: It is splitting away from Africa along the Rift Valley.

name: Sunda plate
fact: The Indian Ocean tsunami came from its western edge.

name: Transition zone of the Earth
fact: The same minerals repack themselves there under pressure.

name: Volcanology
fact: Much of the work is forecasting, and it is done with instruments on the mountain.

name: Volcanism
fact: It is how a planet lets out its heat and builds its air.

name: Abrasion in geology
fact: Rock carries the tools that cut rock.

name: Highland
fact: Thinner soils, shorter seasons, and different farming.

name: Coastal plain
fact: Often sea floor that has been lifted or left behind.

name: Isostatic depression
fact: An ice sheet pushes the land down like a hand on a cushion.

name: Escarpment
fact: One hard layer holds the edge up while the soft ones wear back.

name: Speleology
fact: Half science, half expedition, and often done on one's belly.

name: Solutional cave
fact: Slightly acid rainwater dissolves the rock away along its cracks.

name: Lava tube
fact: The flow crusts over, and the river inside drains away.

name: River morphology
fact: Meanders, braids and straight reaches are each a solution to the same problem.

name: Cut bank
fact: The outside of the bend is where the current runs fastest.

name: Promontory
fact: Hard rock holding out while the softer rock beside it goes.

name: Stream bed
fact: What it is made of decides what the river can do.

name: Gully
fact: It can cut through a ploughed field in a single storm.

name: Ravine
fact: Between a gully and a canyon in size.

name: Wadi
fact: Dry for years, then dangerous for an hour.

name: Cirque
fact: The hollow where the glacier was born, often holding a small lake now.

name: Esker
fact: A river bed left standing above the ground it ran through.

name: Post glacial rebound
fact: Scandinavia is still rising a centimetre a year.

name: U shaped valley
fact: A river cuts a V; a glacier grinds it into a U.

name: Mountain formation
fact: Folding, faulting and volcanism, usually in combination.

name: Fault block
fact: One block goes up, its neighbour drops, and you get basin and range.

name: Fold mountains
fact: The strata were flat once, and you can see them bent.

name: Oceanic basin
fact: They are young, because the sea floor is constantly remade.

name: Shingle beach
fact: The waves sort the stones by size along its length.

name: Coastal geography
fact: It takes in both the physical shaping and the people who live there.

name: Coastal management
fact: Holding one stretch of coast usually starves the next one along.

name: Flat coast
fact: Sand, dunes and marsh rather than cliffs.

name: Headland
fact: The waves bend around it and concentrate their force on its tip.

name: Cape in geography
fact: Sailors have always counted their voyages by them.

name: Tidal island
fact: Twice a day it decides whether it is an island.

name: Barrier island
fact: They take the storm so the mainland does not.

name: Coral island
fact: Built by animals, and rarely more than a few metres above the sea.

name: Islet
fact: Too small to settle, but still land.

name: Lake island
fact: Some lakes hold islands with lakes of their own.

name: River island
fact: The river builds them and the river takes them away.

name: Guyot
fact: It was an island once, and the waves planed it off.

name: Mudflat
fact: They look empty and they feed millions of birds.

name: Shoal
fact: The reason a chart is worth reading.

name: Hummock
fact: A landslide or a melting ice sheet leaves fields of them.

name: Tor rock formation
fact: The joints rotted away underground and the sound blocks were left standing.

name: Lava field
fact: Iceland has ones you can walk across for a day.

name: Volcanic cone
fact: The slope settles at the steepest angle the loose ash will hold.

name: Flash flood
fact: Water arriving from a storm you never saw.

name: Salinity
fact: It governs density, and so it drives the deep circulation.

name: Fresh water
fact: A fortieth of the planet's water, and most of that is frozen.

name: Brackish water
fact: Estuaries are brackish, and demand a lot of their inhabitants.

name: Saline water
fact: Almost all the water on Earth is this.

name: Whirlpool
fact: The dangerous ones form where tides race through narrows.

name: Marine chemistry
fact: The sea's composition has been remarkably steady for a very long time.

name: Ocean dynamics
fact: Wind drives the top, and density drives the rest.

name: Ekman transport
fact: The spin of the Earth turns the flow sideways with depth.

name: Rip current
fact: Swim along the beach, not against it.

name: Ocean surface topography
fact: Satellites measure them to a few centimetres, and read the currents from them.

name: Ocean temperature
fact: It changes slowly, which is what makes the sea a flywheel for climate.

name: Sea surface temperature
fact: It is what hurricanes feed on, and what satellites watch.

name: Abyssal zone
fact: Most of the ocean floor lies within it.

name: Marine sediment
fact: A core of it is a diary of the climate.

name: Sea level rise
fact: Warming water expands, and melting ice adds to it.

name: Tidal range
fact: It is barely noticeable in some seas and the height of a house in others.

name: Megatsunami
fact: A rockfall into a bay can raise a wave taller than any ship.

name: Glaciology
fact: Ice turns out to be a rock that flows.

name: Basal sliding
fact: Much of a glacier's speed is simply slipping.

name: Crevasse
fact: The ice flows where it is deep, and cracks where it is shallow.

name: Methane clathrate
fact: Ice that burns, and there is a great deal of it on the sea floor.

name: Discharge in hydrology
fact: One number that sums up a whole catchment's weather.

name: Streamflow
fact: What reaches the river after the ground has taken its share.

name: Artesian well
fact: The water is pressed up by the weight of the water behind it.

name: Water table
fact: Dig below it and the hole fills by itself.

name: Alpine lake
fact: Cold, clear, and ice-covered for much of the year.

name: Salt flat
fact: What is left when a desert lake dries out.

name: Glacial lake
fact: The ice digs the hollow and then fills it on the way out.

name: Proglacial lake
fact: When the dam fails the flood can rewrite a valley.

name: Pluvial lake
fact: Dry basins in the west of America were full lakes during the ice age.

name: Rift lake
fact: They are long, narrow and extraordinarily deep.

name: Lake stratification
fact: In spring and autumn the layers overturn and mix.

name: Underground lake
fact: Most are in cave country, where the rock dissolves.

name: Volcanic crater lake
fact: Some are acid enough to strip metal.

name: Alluvial river
fact: It builds its own channel, and moves it when it pleases.

name: Arroyo watercourse
fact: A road through one is a bad place to park.

name: Avulsion of a river
fact: A river can change its mouth by many miles in a single flood.

name: Distributary
fact: On a delta the river divides instead of gathering.

name: Confluence
fact: Cities grow at them, because that is where the routes meet.

name: River mouth
fact: The current slows, and everything it carried settles out.

name: River source
fact: Which trickle counts as the source is often a matter of argument.

name: Mathematician
fact: The work is mostly finding out why something is true.

name: Recreational mathematics
fact: Serious results have come out of puzzles more than once.

name: Approximation
fact: Knowing how wrong you are is as useful as being right.

name: Estimation
fact: A good estimate beats an exact answer you cannot get.

name: Extrapolation
fact: Safe for a short step, and treacherous further out.

name: Rounding
fact: How you round at a half is a convention, and it matters.

name: Constant in mathematics
fact: Some are fixed by the problem, and a few are fixed for all mathematics.

name: Monomial
fact: The brick that polynomials are built from.

name: Binomial polynomial
fact: Raising one to a power is where Pascal's triangle comes from.

name: Trinomial
fact: The quadratic you learn to factorise is one.

name: Transfinite number
fact: Cantor showed there is more than one size of infinity.

name: Mathematical notation
fact: Good notation does part of the thinking for you.

name: Mathematical problem
fact: Some have stood unsolved for centuries.

name: Mathematical puzzle
fact: The pleasure is in the argument, not the arithmetic.

name: Corollary
fact: Something you get almost for free once the theorem is in hand.

name: Lemma in mathematics
fact: A few lemmas have outlived the theorems they were built for.

name: Operation in mathematics
fact: Adding, multiplying and the rest are all one idea.

name: Recursion
fact: A definition that uses itself, and still ends.

name: Sign in mathematics
fact: Two rules of sign cover every multiplication.

name: Normal number
fact: Almost every number is one, and hardly any are known to be.

name: Gaussian integer
fact: They make a grid, and they have their own primes.

name: Rate in mathematics
fact: Speed, pressure and interest are all rates.

name: Repeating decimal
fact: Every fraction does this, and only fractions do.

name: Algebraic number
fact: The square root of two is one; most numbers are not.

name: Transcendental number
fact: Proving a given number is one is usually very hard.

name: Constructible number
fact: It is why you cannot trisect an angle with those tools.

name: Computable number
fact: Almost all real numbers are not computable.

name: Decimal separator
fact: A point in some countries and a comma in others.

name: Chinese numerals
fact: One set is written so that it cannot be altered on a cheque.

name: Egyptian numerals
fact: A different sign for each power of ten, repeated as needed.

name: Multiplicative inverse
fact: Dividing is just multiplying by this.

name: Product in mathematics
fact: The word reaches far past numbers, to matrices and sets.

name: Divisibility rule
fact: Add the digits, and you know about three and nine.

name: Egyptian fraction
fact: The Egyptians wrote every fraction this way, and it is still studied.

name: Modulo
fact: Clock arithmetic, and the basis of most cryptography.

name: Algebraic function
fact: Roots and ratios qualify; the sine does not.

name: Function of a real variable
fact: The ordinary kind, whose graph you can draw.

name: Vector valued function
fact: One number in, a whole arrow out.

name: Arithmetic function
fact: They are how number theory describes the integers to itself.

name: Implicit function
fact: The circle is given this way, and it is not a function until you cut it.

name: Parameter
fact: It is held fixed while the variables move.

name: Even and odd functions
fact: Symmetry you can read straight off the graph.

name: Piecewise function
fact: A tax table is one, and so is a parking charge.

name: Injective function
fact: No two inputs share an output.

name: Surjective function
fact: Nothing in the target is left unhit.

name: Bijection
fact: It is how you say two sets are the same size, even when they are infinite.

name: Domain of a function
fact: Half of defining a function is saying what you may feed it.

name: Range of a function
fact: The ambiguity in the word is why mathematicians prefer image.

name: Zero of a function
fact: Solving an equation is finding the zeros of something.

name: Fixed point in mathematics
fact: Stir a cup of tea and some point of it ends where it began.

name: Fixed point theorem
fact: They prove that solutions exist without producing them.

name: Multivalued function
fact: The square root wants to be one, which is why we choose a branch.

name: Partial function
fact: Division is one, because you cannot divide by zero.

name: Bounded function
fact: Its graph stays inside a horizontal band.

name: Analytic function
fact: Knowing it near one point fixes it everywhere, which is remarkable.

name: Entire function
fact: If it stays bounded, it must be constant.

name: Elliptic function
fact: Periodic twice over, like a pattern on wallpaper.

name: Periodic function
fact: Everything that oscillates is described with these.

name: Elementary function
fact: Plenty of simple-looking integrals leave this class.

name: Rational function
fact: Fractions of polynomials, with holes where the bottom vanishes.

name: Linear function in calculus
fact: The simplest function worth the name, and the one everything else is compared to.

name: Identity function
fact: It does nothing, which is exactly why it is useful.

name: Quadratic function
fact: Its graph is a parabola, and a thrown ball follows one.

name: Cubic function
fact: It always crosses the axis at least once.

name: Exponential growth
fact: Slow at first and then faster than anyone expects.

name: Gaussian function
fact: It turns up wherever many small effects are added together.

name: Common logarithm
fact: It is the one in slide rules, decibels and acidity.

name: Natural logarithm
fact: It is the area under a curve, and it chose itself.

name: Binary logarithm
fact: It counts how many times you can halve something.

name: Complex logarithm
fact: It has infinitely many values, one for each turn around the origin.

name: Cube root
fact: Every real number has exactly one real cube root, negatives included.

name: Inverse trigonometric functions
fact: They give you back the angle from the ratio.

name: Bessel function
fact: They are what sines become on a drumhead.

name: Floor and ceiling functions
fact: Rounding down and rounding up, made exact.

name: Stirling's approximation
fact: It makes an unmanageable product into a manageable formula.

name: Prime counting function
fact: How closely it follows a smooth curve is the deepest question in the subject.

name: Euler's totient function
fact: Public key cryptography leans on it.

name: Mobius function
fact: It is zero whenever a square divides the number.

name: Riemann zeta function
fact: Where its zeros lie is the most famous open problem in mathematics.

name: Error function
fact: It has no elementary formula, which is why it has a name.

name: Step function
fact: It jumps rather than climbs.

name: Heaviside step function
fact: It is how you write switching the current on.

name: Sign function
fact: It throws away everything but the direction.

name: Dirac delta function
fact: Infinitely tall, infinitely narrow, and with an area of one.

name: Kronecker delta
fact: It is the identity matrix, written as a formula.

name: Absolute value
fact: It is simply how far the number is from zero.

name: Lambert function
fact: It solves equations where the unknown appears both inside and outside an exponent.

name: Likelihood function
fact: It asks which explanation makes what we saw least surprising.

name: Cylindrical coordinate system
fact: A distance, an angle and a height.

name: Spherical coordinate system
fact: It is latitude and longitude, with a radius added.

name: Polytope
fact: It generalises the polygon and the polyhedron to any number of dimensions.

name: Zero dimensional space
fact: A scatter of separate points, with nothing joining them.

name: One dimensional space
fact: The number line is the example.

name: Direction in geometry
fact: Which way, with nothing said about how far.

name: Congruence in geometry
fact: You could lay one on the other and see no difference.

name: Similarity in geometry
fact: Same angles, and all lengths in one ratio.

name: Isometry
fact: Slides, turns and reflections, but no stretching.

name: Scaling in geometry
fact: Every length multiplied by the same number.

name: Function of several real variables
fact: Its graph is a surface rather than a curve.

name: Additive function
fact: It turns multiplication into addition, where the parts share no factor.

name: Multiplicative function
fact: Knowing it on prime powers tells you it everywhere.

name: Real valued function
fact: The ordinary kind, whatever it takes as input.

name: Inverse hyperbolic functions
fact: Each of them can be written with a logarithm.

name: Shear mapping
fact: It slants a square into a parallelogram and keeps the area.

name: Two dimensional space
fact: Two numbers fix any point in it.

name: Coplanarity
fact: Any three points are, and the fourth is the test.

name: Dihedral angle
fact: It is what a chemist means by the twist in a molecule.

name: Internal and external angles
fact: The exterior angles of any polygon add to one full turn.

name: Regular polygon
fact: All sides equal and all angles equal.

name: Star polygon
fact: The five-pointed star is drawn without lifting the pen.

name: Solid geometry
fact: Volumes and surfaces, rather than lines and areas.

name: Surface of revolution
fact: It is what a potter's wheel makes.

name: Skew lines
fact: Only space allows it; on a flat page it cannot happen.

name: Regular polyhedron
fact: There are exactly five, which the Greeks already knew.

name: Regular dodecahedron
fact: Plato gave it the whole cosmos to represent.

name: Regular icosahedron
fact: Many viruses build their shells in this shape.

name: Four dimensional space
fact: You cannot picture it, but you can calculate in it perfectly well.

name: Sphere in four dimensions
fact: Its surface is three-dimensional, which is the hard part to imagine.

name: Law of sines
fact: Two angles and a side are enough to solve the triangle.

name: Triangulation
fact: It mapped countries before any satellite did.

name: Brouwer fixed point theorem
fact: Stir your coffee and some point of it ends where it started.

name: Connected space
fact: All of one piece, however you try to cut it.

name: Differentiable manifold
fact: Curved space you can still do calculus on.

name: Homeomorphism
fact: It is why a doughnut and a teacup are the same shape.

name: Orientability
fact: A Mobius strip has none, which is why it has one side.

name: Winding number
fact: Count the turns, and note that they can be negative.

name: Surface area
fact: For a given volume, the sphere needs the least.

name: Arc length
fact: Straighten the string, then measure it.

name: Euclidean space
fact: Flat, with distances and angles as we expect them.

name: Affine geometry
fact: Parallel stays parallel, but nothing has a length.

name: Affine transformation
fact: Any combination of stretching, sliding, turning and shearing.

name: Elliptic geometry
fact: On a sphere, every pair of great circles meets.

name: Hyperbolic triangle
fact: Its angles add to less than a half turn, and never to the same amount.

name: Inversive geometry
fact: Turn the plane inside out through a circle.

name: Projective plane
fact: The parallel lines of a painting meet on the horizon.

name: Projective space
fact: Points at infinity are included on the same footing.

name: Curvature
fact: A tight bend has a lot of it, a straight line none.

name: Bisection
fact: Compass and straightedge can halve any angle but not third it.

name: Locus in mathematics
fact: A circle is the locus of points at a fixed distance from a centre.

name: Field line
fact: Iron filings on paper draw them for you.

name: Algebraic expression
fact: It says nothing on its own; an equation says something.

name: Algebraic equation
fact: Whether a formula for its roots exists depends on the degree.

name: Quadratic formula
fact: Known in some form for four thousand years.

name: Cubic equation
fact: Solving it publicly in Renaissance Italy caused a famous quarrel.

name: Binomial theorem
fact: Its coefficients are the rows of Pascal's triangle.

name: Factorization
fact: Breaking a thing into the pieces it is made of.

name: Integer factorization
fact: It is easy to multiply and hard to undo, and banking depends on that.

name: Basis in linear algebra
fact: Choosing one is choosing your axes.

name: Linear combination
fact: Scale them and add them, nothing more.

name: Linear independence
fact: None of them is redundant.

name: Linear map
fact: Every one of them is a matrix once you choose a basis.

name: Cramer's rule
fact: Elegant on paper, and far too slow in practice.

name: Jacobi method
fact: Guess, correct, and repeat until it settles.

name: Scalar multiplication
fact: It stretches the arrow without turning it.

name: Vector notation
fact: An arrow on top, or bold type, or an underline.

name: Einstein notation
fact: Einstein joked that it was his greatest discovery.

name: Metric tensor
fact: It is what makes a curved space into a shape with a size.

name: Matrix multiplication
fact: The order matters, which surprises everyone at first.

name: Transpose
fact: Rows become columns.

name: Rank in linear algebra
fact: How much of the space the matrix can actually reach.

name: Diagonal matrix
fact: It simply stretches each axis by its own factor.

name: Triangular matrix
fact: Equations in this form solve themselves by back-substitution.

name: Lower and upper decomposition
fact: It is how a computer really solves a linear system.

name: Banach space
fact: It has lengths, and no gaps where a limit should be.

name: Tensor product
fact: It is how two systems are combined in quantum mechanics.

name: Inner product space
fact: It restores geometry to an abstract space.

name: Cauchy Schwarz inequality
fact: Perhaps the most useful inequality in all of mathematics.

name: Lie algebra
fact: It captures the rotations near the identity, in linear form.

name: Norm in mathematics
fact: It is how long the arrow is.

name: Triangle inequality
fact: The direct route is never longer.

name: Galois group
fact: It is why there is no formula for the general fifth-degree equation.

name: Homogeneous polynomial
fact: Scaling the variables simply scales the whole thing.

name: Quadratic form
fact: Energy and distance are usually written as one.

name: Homomorphism
fact: It may lose information, but it never breaks the rules.

name: Identity element
fact: Zero for adding, one for multiplying.

name: Inverse element
fact: Whatever undoes what you just did.

name: Monoid
fact: A group without the requirement that anything can be undone.

name: Cyclic group
fact: Keep applying one move and you get the whole thing.

name: Conjugacy class
fact: The same move, seen from a different angle.

name: Lagrange's theorem in group theory
fact: A simple counting fact with very long consequences.

name: Lie group
fact: The rotations of space form one, and physics is built on them.

name: Normal subgroup
fact: Only these let you form a quotient group.

name: Simple group
fact: They are the primes that all finite groups are built from.

name: Classification of finite simple groups
fact: The proof runs to tens of thousands of pages.

name: Algebra over a field
fact: A space where you can add, scale and also multiply.

name: Finite field
fact: Its size is always a prime or a power of one.

name: Field extension
fact: Adding a missing root and seeing what else comes with it.

name: Polynomial ring
fact: Polynomials behave very much like whole numbers.

name: Height
fact: Always measured against something, usually the ground or the sea.

name: Hyperbolic angle
fact: It is an area that behaves exactly like an angle.

name: Homography
fact: It is how a photograph of a flat wall is straightened.

name: Remarkable theorem of Gauss
fact: Curvature can be measured from inside a surface, which is why no flat map of the Earth is faithful.

name: Lattice in group theory
fact: The repeating pattern behind every crystal.

name: Minkowski's theorem
fact: A statement about area that settles questions about whole numbers.

name: Horner's method
fact: It rewrites the polynomial so each step is one multiply and one add.

name: Gauss Seidel method
fact: It uses each new value as soon as it has it.

name: Rank nullity theorem
fact: What the map keeps and what it crushes always add up.

name: Identity matrix
fact: Multiplying by it changes nothing.

name: Isomorphism theorems
fact: They say that quotienting and mapping agree.

name: Alternating group
fact: For five or more objects it is simple, which is why the quintic has no formula.

name: Modular group
fact: It tiles the hyperbolic plane with triangles.

name: Hilbert's basis theorem
fact: Hilbert proved it without constructing the set, which scandalised his contemporaries.

name: Ideal in ring theory
fact: It is what you quotient by, as multiples of a number are in arithmetic.

name: Affine space
fact: Points and differences, but no privileged zero.

name: Exterior algebra
fact: Swapping two factors flips the sign.

name: Moduli space
fact: Every point of it is a whole shape.

name: Resultant
fact: One number that answers whether two curves meet.

name: Probability space
fact: What can happen, which events we can speak of, and how likely each is.

name: Sample space
fact: Everything that could come out, listed once.

name: Chebyshev's inequality
fact: It holds whatever the distribution, which is its point.

name: Conditional probability
fact: Most mistakes in probability are mistakes about this.

name: Coefficient of determination
fact: How much of the scatter the line actually explains.

name: Correlation coefficient
fact: It runs from minus one to one, and zero means no straight-line relation.

name: Skewness
fact: One tail longer than the other.

name: Kurtosis
fact: It is about rare extremes, not about the peak.

name: Moment generating function
fact: One function that carries the mean, the variance and everything after.

name: Viterbi algorithm
fact: It decodes the signal in every mobile phone.

name: Martingale in probability theory
fact: A fair game, in which no betting system can help.

name: Poisson point process
fact: Raindrops on a path, or calls arriving at an exchange.

name: Wiener process
fact: It is continuous everywhere and smooth nowhere.

name: Cumulative distribution function
fact: It climbs from zero to one and never comes down.

name: Probability mass function
fact: One bar for each outcome, and they add to one.

name: Beta distribution
fact: It is the natural way to describe an unknown proportion.

name: Chi squared distribution
fact: It is the workhorse of tests on counts and variances.

name: Continuous uniform distribution
fact: Flat across its range, and nothing favoured.

name: Gamma distribution
fact: It models waiting times for several events in a row.

name: Multivariate normal distribution
fact: Its contours are ellipses, and the matrix says how they lean.

name: Student's t distribution
fact: Published under a pen name because the brewery forbade publishing.

name: Bernoulli distribution
fact: One coin, one toss.

name: Geometric distribution
fact: It has no memory, which surprises people who wait for buses.

name: Autocorrelation
fact: It reveals a rhythm hiding in noise.

name: Credible interval
fact: It says what you believe, which is what people wrongly think a confidence interval says.

name: Posterior probability
fact: Belief after the evidence.

name: Prior probability
fact: Belief before the evidence, and choosing it honestly is the hard part.

name: Confidence interval
fact: The confidence is in the method, not in the particular interval.

name: Descriptive statistics
fact: It summarises what you have, and claims nothing beyond it.

name: Factorial experiment
fact: It finds the interactions that one-at-a-time testing misses.

name: Split testing
fact: It is an experiment, and most web traffic is in one.

name: Estimator
fact: Judged by whether it is unbiased and how much it varies.

name: Frequentist inference
fact: It asks what would happen if the study were repeated for ever.

name: Mathematical statistics
fact: The theory behind the methods rather than the practice of them.

name: Arithmetic mean
fact: One large value can drag it a long way.

name: Geometric mean
fact: The right average for growth rates and ratios.

name: Harmonic mean
fact: It is the right one for speeds over the same distance.

name: Sample mean and covariance
fact: Our best guesses at the real mean and spread.

name: Statistical inference
fact: Reasoning from the part to the whole, with the uncertainty attached.

name: Time series
fact: The order matters, which breaks most ordinary statistics.

name: Type one and type two errors
fact: Crying wolf, and missing the wolf.

name: Analysis of variance
fact: It asks whether the differences between groups exceed the noise within them.

name: Correlation does not imply causation
fact: Something else may be causing both.

name: Ecological fallacy
fact: What holds for the country need not hold for anybody in it.

name: Least squares
fact: The line that leaves the smallest total of squared misses.

name: Logistic regression
fact: It keeps the prediction between zero and one, where probabilities belong.

name: Margin of error
fact: It covers only sampling, not the many other ways a poll can be wrong.

name: Sample size determination
fact: Too few proves nothing, too many wastes effort.

name: Sampling error
fact: It shrinks as the sample grows, and never quite vanishes.

name: Box plot
fact: Five numbers, and the outliers shown separately.

name: Candlestick chart
fact: Each candle carries the open, close, high and low of a period.

name: Correlogram
fact: It shows at a glance which lags matter.

name: Radar chart
fact: It flatters whichever variable you put first.

name: Stem and leaf display
fact: Unlike a histogram, it keeps every original value.

name: Violin plot
fact: A box plot with the whole shape of the distribution drawn on.

name: Foundations of mathematics
fact: Asking what a proof is, and what we are allowed to assume.

name: Rule of inference
fact: They are the legal moves of an argument.

name: Well formed formula
fact: Grammatical, which is not the same as true.

name: Atomic formula
fact: The smallest statement that can be true or false.

name: Higher order logic
fact: More expressive, and it gives up completeness for it.

name: Intuitionistic logic
fact: To prove something exists, you must show how to find it.

name: Karnaugh map
fact: Neighbouring squares differ in one variable, so the groupings leap out.

name: Logical connective
fact: And, or, not, and if then.

name: If and only if
fact: It is two implications in one, and both must be proved.

name: Material conditional
fact: It counts as true whenever the first part is false, which troubles beginners.

name: Negation
fact: Doing it twice gets you back where you started, in classical logic at least.

name: Reduction to absurdity
fact: Assume the opposite, and watch it fall apart.

name: Infinite regress
fact: Every explanation needs another, and nothing is ever settled.

name: Contraposition
fact: If something follows from a claim, then failing that denies the claim.

name: Principle of explosion
fact: One inconsistency, and the whole system proves everything.

name: Tautology in logic
fact: True by its shape, and so it tells you nothing about the world.

name: Quantifier in logic
fact: All, or at least one, and the order of them matters.

name: Existential quantification
fact: It claims at least one, and says nothing about which.

name: Universal quantification
fact: One counterexample is enough to destroy it.

name: Complement in set theory
fact: Everything else, within whatever you are counting as everything.

name: Free and bound variables
fact: Renaming a bound one changes nothing; renaming a free one changes everything.

name: Prenex normal form
fact: All the quantifiers pulled to the front.

name: Partition of a set
fact: Nothing left out, and nothing in two places.

name: Equivalence class
fact: Treating as one everything you have agreed not to distinguish.

name: Tuple
fact: Unlike a set, the order matters and repeats are allowed.

name: Cartesian product
fact: It is the grid you get by crossing one list with another.

name: Ordered pair
fact: Coordinates on a map are one.

name: Binary relation
fact: Is less than, is a parent of, lives in: all relations.

name: Reflexive relation
fact: Is equal to is reflexive; is older than is not.

name: Symmetric relation
fact: Is a sibling of works both ways.

name: Transitive relation
fact: Is an ancestor of is transitive; is a parent of is not.

name: Multiset
fact: Like a set, but it counts the copies.

name: Mathematical structure
fact: A bare set can do nothing until you add something to it.

name: Cardinal number
fact: It answers how many, even when the answer is infinite.

name: Aleph number
fact: The first of them counts the whole numbers.

name: Cantor's theorem
fact: There is no largest infinity.

name: Cardinality of the continuum
fact: Strictly more than the whole numbers, as Cantor showed with his diagonal.

name: Continuum hypothesis
fact: It can be neither proved nor disproved from the usual axioms.

name: Power set
fact: For a set of ten things it already has more than a thousand members.

name: Transfinite induction
fact: Induction that carries on past infinity.

name: Large cardinal
fact: Their existence cannot be proved, only assumed, and the assumptions line up in a tower.

name: Axiom of extensionality
fact: A set is nothing more than what is in it.

name: Axiom of regularity
fact: It stops the chain of membership going down for ever.

name: Axiom schema of specification
fact: It is the restriction that averted Russell's paradox.

name: Axiom of union
fact: It pours the boxes out into one.

name: Axiom of infinity
fact: Without it, the whole numbers could not be built.

name: Axiom of power set
fact: It is what makes the uncountable possible.

name: Well ordering theorem
fact: It is equivalent to the axiom of choice, and much harder to believe.

name: Hilbert's axioms
fact: He repaired the gaps that Euclid had left unstated for two thousand years.

name: Church Turing thesis
fact: It is a claim about what computing means, so it cannot be proved.

name: Model of computation
fact: Different models, and so far all equal in what they can compute.

name: Combinatory logic
fact: Everything is built from a couple of combinators and nothing else.

name: General recursive function
fact: Exactly what a Turing machine can compute, reached by another road.

name: Primitive recursive function
fact: It covers almost everything, and still misses some computable functions.

name: Godel numbering
fact: It lets arithmetic talk about its own statements.

name: Decision problem
fact: The ones that no algorithm can settle are the interesting ones.

name: Halting problem
fact: Turing proved that no program can decide it.

name: Rice's theorem
fact: It generalises the halting problem to almost every question about programs.

name: Turing's proof
fact: The machine he invented to prove it became the computer.

name: Universal Turing machine
fact: One machine that can be any machine, which is what a computer is.

name: Computable set
fact: Most sets are not, since there are more sets than programs.

name: Oracle machine
fact: Supposing a problem solved, and asking what follows.

name: Turing reduction
fact: It says the second problem is at least as hard.

name: Proof theory
fact: Proofs studied as structures rather than as arguments.

name: Model theory
fact: What the axioms are actually talking about.

name: Compactness theorem
fact: It smuggles infinite conclusions out of finite ones.

name: Godel's completeness theorem
fact: Not to be confused with his incompleteness theorems, which say the opposite about arithmetic.

name: Lowenheim Skolem theorem
fact: A theory about uncountable things always has a countable model too.

name: Elementary equivalence
fact: Indistinguishable from inside the language, though possibly quite different.

name: Quantifier elimination
fact: When it works, the theory becomes decidable.

name: Commutative diagram
fact: However you go round, you arrive at the same place.

name: Morphism
fact: The arrow matters more than what it connects.

name: Category in mathematics
fact: It is the mathematics of composing one thing after another.

name: Functor
fact: It carries whole structures across, arrows and all.

name: Adjoint functors
fact: It turns up everywhere once you learn to see it.

name: Universal property
fact: Define a thing by its job, not by its construction.

name: Coproduct
fact: The product turned round.

name: Initial and terminal objects
fact: The empty set and the one-point set, in the category of sets.

name: Algebraic combinatorics
fact: Counting problems answered with groups and matrices.

name: Enumerative combinatorics
fact: The art of counting without listing.

name: Ramsey theory
fact: Complete disorder is impossible if the thing is big enough.

name: Ramsey's theorem
fact: In any party of six, three are mutual friends or three mutual strangers.

name: Addition principle
fact: Either this way or that way, so add.

name: Rule of product
fact: This way and then that way, so multiply.

name: Inclusion and exclusion principle
fact: Add the parts, take back the overlaps, then put back what you took twice.

name: Pigeonhole principle
fact: Obvious, and the proof of surprisingly deep results.

name: Double counting proof technique
fact: Count the same thing twice, and the answers must agree.

name: Latin square
fact: A completed sudoku is one, with extra conditions.

name: Binomial coefficient
fact: It counts how many ways to choose a handful from a pile.

name: Pascal's triangle
fact: Each number is the sum of the two above it.

name: Partial permutation
fact: An ordered choice, where not everything is chosen.

name: Stirling number
fact: They count the ways of splitting a set into a given number of blocks.

name: Coincidence
fact: With enough chances, the unlikely becomes expected.

name: Kriging
fact: It was invented to estimate ore grades from boreholes.

name: Non linear least squares
fact: It has to be solved by stepping towards the answer.

name: Type theory
fact: It began as a cure for paradox and became the basis of programming languages.

name: Modus tollens
fact: If it had rained the ground would be wet; the ground is dry, so it did not rain.

name: F distribution
fact: It is what analysis of variance compares against.

name: Clique in graph theory
fact: Everyone in it knows everyone else.

name: Graph colouring
fact: Timetabling and radio frequencies are both this problem.

name: Bipartite graph
fact: Workers and jobs, with edges only between.

name: Four colour theorem
fact: The first major theorem proved with the help of a computer.

name: Connectivity in graph theory
fact: It measures how much a network can lose and still hold together.

name: Kruskal's algorithm
fact: Take the cheapest edge that does not close a loop, and repeat.

name: Prim's algorithm
fact: Grow one tree outward, always by the cheapest edge available.

name: Regular graph
fact: Every node equally connected.

name: Flow network
fact: Water in pipes, traffic on roads, data on wires.

name: Complete graph
fact: Every possible connection present.

name: Directed graph
fact: One-way streets rather than two.

name: Graph isomorphism
fact: The same network wearing different names.

name: Planar graph
fact: Whether a circuit can be printed on one layer is this question.

name: Three utilities problem
fact: It cannot be done, and the proof is a piece of topology.

name: Petersen graph
fact: Whenever someone conjectures something about graphs, it is tried on this one first.

name: Adjacency matrix
fact: A one wherever two nodes are joined.

name: Path in graph theory
fact: A route through the network that does not repeat itself.

name: Directed acyclic graph
fact: It can always be laid out so every arrow points forward.

name: Eulerian path
fact: Drawing the figure without lifting the pen or retracing.

name: Seven Bridges of Konigsberg
fact: Euler proved it impossible, and invented graph theory doing it.

name: Hamiltonian path
fact: It sounds like the Eulerian question and is vastly harder.

name: Travelling salesman problem
fact: Easy to state, and one of the hardest problems to solve exactly.

name: Shortest path problem
fact: Every satellite navigation device solves it constantly.

name: Dijkstra's algorithm
fact: It spreads outward from the start, always taking the nearest unvisited node.

name: Hasse diagram
fact: Only the immediate steps are drawn, and height does the rest.

name: Upper and lower bounds
fact: Not necessarily in the set, and not necessarily the smallest such.

name: Infimum and supremum
fact: They exist even when the set has no smallest or largest member.

name: Indeterminate form
fact: Zero over zero tells you nothing until you look closer.

name: Infinitesimal
fact: Banished for a century and then made rigorous after all.

name: Series expansion
fact: It turns an awkward function into arithmetic you can truncate.

name: Linear approximation
fact: Close enough, if you do not go far.

name: Differential operator
fact: It treats differentiation itself as a thing you can do algebra with.

name: Second derivative
fact: It tells you about acceleration, and which way a curve bends.

name: Time derivative
fact: Velocity is one, and acceleration is the next.

name: Closure in mathematics
fact: Add two whole numbers and you get a whole number; divide them and you may not.

name: Ordinal number
fact: It records the order, not just how many.

name: Axiomatic system
fact: Everything else in the subject has to be earned from these.

name: Axiom of pairing
fact: The smallest possible act of set building.

name: Axiom schema of replacement
fact: It is what lets you build sets too large to specify directly.

name: New Foundations
fact: It allows a set of everything, and avoids paradox by other means.

name: Tarski's axioms
fact: Points only; no lines, no sets, and the whole theory is decidable.

name: Mu operator
fact: It is the step that lets a program run for ever.

name: The decision problem of Hilbert
fact: Church and Turing showed independently that there is none.

name: Computably enumerable set
fact: You can list them all; you may never be able to say what is missing.

name: Turing degree
fact: Degrees of impossibility, arranged in an order.

name: Skolem's paradox
fact: Countable from outside, uncountable from within.

name: Ultraproduct
fact: It builds a new structure that inherits whatever most of the old ones shared.

name: Five lemma
fact: If the four outer maps behave, the middle one must too.

name: Cartesian closed category
fact: It is the categorical shape of a programming language.

name: Concrete category
fact: Its objects really are sets with structure, and its arrows really are functions.

name: Opposite category
fact: Every theorem comes with a free second theorem, read backwards.

name: Subcategory
fact: A part that is still a category in its own right.

name: Forgetful functor
fact: A group has a set underneath it, and the functor is that underneath.

name: Hom functor
fact: It looks at an object entirely through the arrows that reach it.

name: Yoneda lemma
fact: An object is completely determined by how everything else maps into it.

name: Free object
fact: It obeys only the rules it must, and no others.

name: Natural transformation
fact: Natural was given a precise meaning, and the whole subject grew out of defining it.

name: Combinatorial principles
fact: Half a dozen small ideas that do most of the work.

name: Twelvefold way
fact: One table that answers a dozen questions about balls and boxes.

name: Stirling numbers of the first kind
fact: They count the arrangements with a given number of cycles.

name: Stirling numbers of the second kind
fact: Boxes without labels, so only the grouping counts.

name: Lah number
fact: They count the ways to split a set into ordered lists.

name: Clique problem
fact: One of the first problems ever shown to be hard in the deepest sense.

name: Chromatic polynomial
fact: One polynomial answers the question for every palette at once.

name: Component in graph theory
fact: The separate islands a network falls into.

name: Edge cover
fact: Choose enough connections that nobody is left out.

name: Ford Fulkerson algorithm
fact: Find a route with spare room, use it, and repeat.

name: Max flow min cut theorem
fact: The bottleneck is exactly the limit.

name: Maximum flow problem
fact: Traffic, water and shipping all ask this.

name: Multigraph
fact: Two bridges between the same banks are two edges.

name: Graph homomorphism
fact: Colouring a graph is a homomorphism in disguise.

name: Edge contraction
fact: Pinch the edge out and glue the ends together.

name: Graph automorphism
fact: Relabelling the nodes and finding nothing has changed.

name: Cayley graph
fact: It turns an abstract group into a shape you can walk around.

name: Hypergraph
fact: An edge becomes a committee rather than a handshake.

name: Matching in graph theory
fact: Pair everyone off, and nobody twice.

name: Vertex cover
fact: Guards at junctions, watching every street.

name: Crossing number in graph theory
fact: Zero exactly when the graph is planar.

name: Kuratowski's theorem
fact: Two forbidden shapes, and no others.

name: Spectral graph theory
fact: The numbers hidden in the matrix tell you how the network is shaped.

name: Laplacian matrix
fact: Counting spanning trees falls straight out of it.

name: Girth in graph theory
fact: A graph with no cycle at all is said to have infinite girth.

name: Handshaking lemma
fact: At any party, an even number of people have shaken hands an odd number of times.

name: Hamiltonian path problem
fact: No efficient method is known, and most believe none exists.

name: A star search algorithm
fact: It guesses how far is left to go, and searches towards the guess.

name: Bellman Ford algorithm
fact: Slower than its rivals, but it copes with negative weights.

name: Floyd Warshall algorithm
fact: Three nested loops, and every route is solved at once.

name: Domain theory
fact: It gave a meaning to computer programs that may never finish.

name: Stable matching problem
fact: Doctors are assigned to hospitals this way.

name: Gale Shapley algorithm
fact: It always terminates, and it favours whichever side does the proposing.

name: Differentiation rules
fact: A handful of rules cover almost everything you meet.

name: Product rule
fact: It is not the product of the derivatives, which is the usual first mistake.

name: Chain rule
fact: Differentiate the outside, then multiply by the derivative of the inside.

name: Power rule
fact: Bring the power down in front and reduce it by one.

name: Quotient rule
fact: It follows from the product rule, if you would rather remember one thing.

name: Differentiation of trigonometric functions
fact: Sine becomes cosine, and four steps bring you back where you began.

name: Rule of L'Hopital
fact: Differentiate top and bottom separately, which is not the quotient rule.

name: Taylor's theorem
fact: It says how good the approximation is, which is the useful part.

name: Related rates
fact: The ladder slides, and the top falls faster than the foot moves.

name: Antiderivative
fact: Differentiation undone, up to a constant.

name: Lebesgue integral
fact: It slices the range instead of the domain, and that changes everything.

name: Riemann integral
fact: Rectangles under the curve, made narrower and narrower.

name: Constant of integration
fact: Every antiderivative has a whole family of siblings.

name: Improper integral
fact: It is defined as a limit, and sometimes the limit is finite anyway.

name: Integration by parts
fact: It is the product rule run backwards.

name: Integration by substitution
fact: The chain rule, read from right to left.

name: Jensen's inequality
fact: The chord lies above the curve, and almost everything in probability follows.

name: Limits of integration
fact: Swap them and the sign changes.

name: Riemann sum
fact: Make the rectangles thin enough and you have the integral.

name: Iterated integral
fact: Do the inner one first, treating the other variable as fixed.

name: Fubini's theorem
fact: Usually the order does not matter, and the theorem says exactly when.

name: Directional derivative
fact: How steep the hill is, in the direction you are facing.

name: Vector field
fact: Wind on a weather map is one.

name: Conservative vector field
fact: Go round any loop and you come back with nothing gained.

name: Gradient
fact: It points straight uphill, and its length is the slope.

name: Divergence
fact: Positive where something is being created, negative where it drains away.

name: Curl in mathematics
fact: Put a tiny paddle wheel in the flow and see if it spins.

name: Laplace operator
fact: It compares a point with the average of its neighbours.

name: Poisson's equation
fact: It links a field to whatever is producing it, in gravity and in electricity alike.

name: Line integral
fact: Work done along a path is one.

name: Surface integral
fact: How much is flowing through the net.

name: Volume integral
fact: Mass from density is the ordinary example.

name: Stokes' theorem
fact: What happens inside is settled entirely at the edge.

name: Green's theorem
fact: It is the flat case of Stokes' theorem.

name: Divergence theorem
fact: Everything leaving the box came from somewhere in the box.

name: Jacobian matrix and determinant
fact: Its determinant says how much a transformation stretches volume.

name: Linear differential equation
fact: Solutions can be added together, which makes them tractable.

name: Boundary value problem
fact: A vibrating string is pinned at both ends.

name: Separation of variables
fact: When it works, two simple integrals finish the job.

name: Euler method
fact: Follow the slope for a short step, then look again.

name: Runge Kutta methods
fact: They sample the slope several times a step, and are far more accurate.

name: Finite element method
fact: Cut the shape into small pieces and solve on each.

name: Nonlinear system
fact: Almost everything real is one, and almost none can be solved exactly.

name: Phase space
fact: Each point is a whole situation, and the motion traces a curve.

name: Butterfly effect
fact: Lorenz found it when he rounded a number and the weather came out different.

name: Ergodic theory
fact: Given long enough, the time average equals the space average.

name: Attractor
fact: Start anywhere nearby and you end up on it.

name: Limit cycle
fact: A rhythm the system settles into whatever you do to it.

name: Generating function
fact: A whole sequence packed into a single function.

name: Summation
fact: The symbol for it is a capital Greek sigma.

name: Convergent series
fact: Infinitely many terms, and still a finite answer.

name: Cauchy sequence
fact: It defines convergence without naming the limit.

name: Geometric series
fact: It converges exactly when the ratio is smaller than one.

name: Power series
fact: A polynomial with no last term.

name: Harmonic series in mathematics
fact: Its terms shrink to nothing, and it still adds up to infinity.

name: Divergent series
