fact: Some can still be assigned a sensible value, with care.

name: Radius of convergence
fact: Even for real functions, the radius is set by trouble in the complex plane.

name: Holder's inequality
fact: It is the tool that makes the whole theory of function spaces work.

name: Operator theory
fact: Matrices again, but with infinitely many rows.

name: Element of a set
fact: Membership is the only relation a bare set offers.

name: Zermelo Fraenkel set theory
fact: Nine or so axioms, and the rest of mathematics follows.

name: Snake lemma
fact: The connecting map zigzags like a snake through the diagram.

name: Mutually orthogonal Latin squares
fact: Euler guessed wrong about which sizes are possible, and it took two centuries to settle.

name: Graph minor
fact: A whole theory of graphs was built on which minors a family forbids.

name: Graph isomorphism problem
fact: It is neither known to be easy nor known to be hard, which is rare.

name: Intersection graph
fact: Every graph is one, for some family of sets.

name: Line graph
fact: Edges become nodes, and shared endpoints become edges.

name: Maximum cardinality matching
fact: Unlike most such problems, it can be solved efficiently.

name: Blossom algorithm
fact: Odd cycles were the obstacle, and shrinking them was the trick.

name: Konig's theorem in graph theory
fact: The largest matching and the smallest cover are the same size.

name: Snark in graph theory
fact: Named after the elusive creature in Lewis Carroll's poem.

name: Degree matrix
fact: Subtract the adjacency matrix from it and you get the Laplacian.

name: Preorder
fact: An order that may call two different things equivalent.

name: Partially ordered set
fact: Subsets under inclusion are the standard example.

name: Antichain
fact: A row of things none of which precedes another.

name: Antisymmetric relation
fact: It is what stops an order from doubling back.

name: Ultrafilter
fact: It decides, of every set, whether it is large or small.

name: Join and meet
fact: The nearest common ancestor, and the nearest common descendant.

name: Total order
fact: Everything can be put in a single line.

name: Connected relation
fact: No two things are left unrelated.

name: Well founded relation
fact: It is what makes induction and recursion legitimate.

name: Greatest and least element
fact: It must be in the set, which is what separates it from an upper bound.

name: Linearization
fact: Engineering runs on it, because straight lines can be solved.

name: Differentiable function
fact: It has no corners and no breaks.

name: Differential form
fact: One language in which all the great theorems of calculus are a single theorem.

name: Gradient theorem
fact: The hill does not care which way you walked up it.

name: Lagrange multiplier
fact: At the best point, the two gradients line up.

name: Helmholtz decomposition
fact: Every field is a flow plus a swirl.

name: Parabolic partial differential equation
fact: The heat equation is the example, and it blurs any sharp edge.

name: Hyperbolic partial differential equation
fact: The wave equation is the example, and it keeps a sharp edge sharp.

name: Elliptic partial differential equation
fact: The answer at every point depends on the boundary everywhere.

name: Homogeneous differential equation
fact: Solutions can be added and scaled, which is what makes them manageable.

name: Convolution
fact: It is what a blur, an echo and a moving average all are.

name: Integrating factor
fact: Multiply by the right thing and the equation solves itself.

name: Shooting method
fact: Aim, fire, see where it lands, and adjust.

name: Crank Nicolson method
fact: It averages the present and the future step, and stays stable.

name: Method of lines
fact: Turn one hard equation into many easy ones.

name: Dirichlet problem
fact: Fix the edge, and the inside is determined.

name: Elliptic operator
fact: They smooth whatever they are applied to.

name: System of differential equations
fact: Everything in it depends on everything else at once.

name: Linear dynamical system
fact: These are the ones that can actually be solved.

name: Stability theory
fact: Nudge it and ask whether it comes back.

name: Bifurcation theory
fact: Turn a knob slowly, and at one point the answer splits in two.

name: Edge of chaos
fact: Interesting things happen where neither rigidity nor randomness wins.

name: Multibody system
fact: It is how robots and vehicles are simulated.

name: Three body problem
fact: Two bodies can be solved exactly; three cannot.

name: Initial condition
fact: The same equation gives a different future from a different start.

name: Conserved quantity
fact: Energy and momentum are the famous ones, and each comes from a symmetry.

name: Flow in mathematics
fact: It is the whole family of trajectories at once.

name: Lyapunov exponent
fact: Positive means chaos, and says how fast prediction fails.

name: Laurent series
fact: It works around a pole, where an ordinary series cannot.

name: Absolute convergence
fact: Then the order of the terms stops mattering.

name: Convergence tests
fact: A dozen tests, and part of the skill is picking one.

name: Binomial series
fact: Newton found it, and it gave him square roots as infinite sums.

name: Space of p integrable functions
fact: The one with p equal to two is the only one with angles in it.

name: Sequence space
fact: Infinitely many coordinates, treated as one point.

name: Uniform convergence
fact: It is the condition under which limits and integrals may be exchanged.

name: Measure in mathematics
fact: Not every set can be measured, which was a shock.

name: Asymptotic analysis
fact: It is how the speed of an algorithm is described.

name: Asymptote
fact: Approached for ever, and never touched.

name: Interpolation
fact: Between the readings; extrapolation goes beyond them, and is far riskier.

name: Number line
fact: Every number has a point, and every point a number.

name: Completeness of the real numbers
fact: It is exactly what the rationals lack, and why calculus needs the reals.

name: Interval in mathematics
fact: Whether the ends are included makes all the difference.

name: Extreme value theorem
fact: It guarantees the maximum exists without finding it.

name: Intermediate value theorem
fact: A curve drawn without lifting the pen must cross the line.

name: Root finding algorithm
fact: Most equations cannot be solved exactly, so they are solved like this.

name: Newton's method
fact: Follow the tangent to where it crosses, and repeat.

name: Bisection method
fact: Slow, and it never fails.

name: Secant method
fact: Newton's method without needing the derivative.

name: Mean value theorem
fact: If you averaged fifty miles an hour, at some moment you were doing exactly that.

name: Stationary point
fact: The tangent is flat, though it need not be a peak or a trough.

name: Inflection point
fact: The slope may be rising throughout, and still the curve turns over.

name: Complex plane
fact: It turns algebra into geometry and back.

name: Riemann sphere
fact: Wrap the plane onto a ball, and infinity becomes an ordinary point.

name: Contour integration
fact: It solves real integrals that have no real method.

name: De Moivre's formula
fact: Raising to a power multiplies the angle.

name: Liouville's theorem in complex analysis
fact: It yields a one-line proof that every polynomial has a root.

name: Conformal map
fact: Shapes are distorted; the corners between them are not.

name: Zeros and poles
fact: Where they are tells you nearly everything about the function.

name: Picard theorem
fact: Near an essential singularity it takes every value but at most one, infinitely often.

name: Residue in complex analysis
fact: The one coefficient that survives when you integrate around it.

name: Residue theorem
fact: An integral reduced to a finite sum.

name: Branch point
fact: Go once round it and you come back on a different sheet.

name: Root of unity
fact: They sit at the corners of a regular polygon on the unit circle.

name: Convolution theorem
fact: It turns a hard operation into an easy one, and back.

name: Fast Fourier transform
fact: It made digital signal processing possible.

name: Harmonic function
fact: Its value at a point is the average over any circle around it.

name: Potential theory
fact: Gravity and electrostatics are the same mathematics.

name: Wavelet
fact: Unlike a sine wave, it is localised, so it tells you when as well as how fast.

name: Divisor
fact: A number's divisors are its whole shape.

name: Least common multiple
fact: Adding fractions needs it.

name: Composite number
fact: Everything that is not prime, except one.

name: Fermat number
fact: He guessed they were all prime; Euler found the fifth is not.

name: Greatest common divisor
fact: Euclid's method for finding it is the oldest algorithm still in use.

name: Highly composite number
fact: Twelve and sixty are why we divide hours and minutes as we do.

name: Mersenne prime
fact: The largest known primes are nearly all of this kind.

name: Semiprime
fact: Public key encryption rests on how hard these are to split.

name: Twin prime
fact: Whether there are infinitely many is still unknown.

name: Coprime integers
fact: They share no factor, though neither need be prime.

name: The abc conjecture
fact: A claimed proof runs to hundreds of pages and is still disputed.

name: Numbers of the p adic kind
fact: Two numbers are close when their difference is divisible by a high power of the prime.

name: Primality test
fact: It can tell you a number is composite without finding a single factor.

name: Pseudoprime
fact: The tests are fast, and these are the price of that speed.

name: Aliquot sum
fact: Compare it with the number itself and you have the ancient classification.

name: Perfect number
fact: Only a few dozen are known, and nobody knows whether any is odd.

name: Collatz conjecture
fact: A child can state it, and nobody can prove it.

name: Integer partition
fact: Order does not matter, and the counts grow astonishingly fast.

name: Goldbach's conjecture
fact: Checked far beyond any doubt, and still unproved.

name: Young tableau
fact: Boxes in rows, filled so that the numbers increase along and down.

name: Magic square
fact: They appear in Chinese records three thousand years old.

name: Triangular number
fact: One, three, six, ten: add the next whole number each time.

name: Chinese remainder theorem
fact: It is at the heart of fast arithmetic on very large numbers.

name: Discrete logarithm
fact: Easy to go forward, and apparently very hard to reverse.

name: Fermat's little theorem
fact: It is the basis of the fastest primality tests we have.

name: Quadratic residue
fact: Which numbers are squares depends entirely on the modulus.

name: Legendre symbol
fact: A notation that turns a question into arithmetic.

name: Quadratic reciprocity
fact: Gauss called it the golden theorem and proved it eight times.

name: Wilson's theorem
fact: Beautiful, and far too slow to use.

name: Arithmetic progression
fact: Add the same amount each time.

name: Dirichlet's theorem on arithmetic progressions
fact: The primes are spread evenly among the residues that could hold them.

name: Catalan number
fact: They count the ways to bracket an expression, and dozens of other things.

name: Geometric progression
fact: Multiply by the same amount each time.

name: Recurrence relation
fact: The Fibonacci numbers are the familiar example.

name: Extended Euclidean algorithm
fact: It is how modular inverses are computed.

name: Mobius inversion formula
fact: It lets you undo a sum over divisors.

name: Decision theory
fact: Weigh each outcome by how likely and how good it is.

name: Music and mathematics
fact: The ratios of a vibrating string were the first physics anyone did.

name: Extensive form game
fact: It shows who moves when, and who knows what.

name: Perfect information
fact: Chess has it; poker does not.

name: Normal form game
fact: Everyone chooses at once, and the grid says what happens.

name: Prisoner's dilemma
fact: Both betray, and both end up worse than if neither had.

name: Zero sum game
fact: Most real situations are not one, which is the useful point.

name: Repeated game
fact: Playing again changes everything, because reputation begins to matter.

name: Minimax
fact: Assume your opponent plays perfectly, and prepare for that.

name: Nash equilibrium
fact: It need not be the best outcome for anyone.

name: Strategic dominance
fact: If a strategy is dominated there is never a reason to play it.

name: Social choice theory
fact: How a group turns individual preferences into one decision.

name: Condorcet paradox
fact: A beats B, B beats C, and C beats A.

name: Arrow's impossibility theorem
fact: No voting system can satisfy every reasonable fairness condition at once.

name: Reed Solomon error correction
fact: They are why a scratched disc still plays.

name: Dynamic programming
fact: Solve each little piece once, and write the answer down.

name: Gradient descent
fact: Walk downhill, in steps, and hope the valley is the right one.

name: Duality in optimization
fact: The best you can get and the least you must pay meet in the middle.

name: Feasible region
fact: The answer always lies on its edge, which is what makes it searchable.

name: Simplex algorithm
fact: It walks from corner to corner of the feasible region, always improving.

name: Loss function
fact: Choosing it is choosing what you think a mistake is worth.

name: Transportation theory in mathematics
fact: It began with Napoleonic earthworks, and now underlies much of machine learning.

name: Assignment problem
fact: Unlike most such problems, it can be solved quickly.

name: Hungarian algorithm
fact: It works on the matrix of costs, subtracting rows and columns.

name: Computation
fact: Whatever can be done by following rules, with no insight required.

name: Analysis of algorithms
fact: How the work grows as the input grows is what matters.

name: Big O notation
fact: Constants are ignored, because the shape of the growth is the point.

name: Deterministic algorithm
fact: No randomness, and no surprises.

name: Search algorithm
fact: Half of computing is finding something you have already stored.

name: Binary search
fact: It finds one item in a million in twenty steps.

name: Breadth first search
fact: It finds the shortest route when every step costs the same.

name: Brute force search
fact: Always correct, and usually hopeless.

name: Depth first search
fact: It is how a maze is solved with one hand on the wall.

name: String searching algorithm
fact: Skipping ahead cleverly is what makes it fast.

name: Heapsort
fact: It needs no extra memory and never has a bad day.

name: Automata theory
fact: Simple machines, and exactly what each kind cannot do.

name: Cellular automaton
fact: Each cell looks only at its neighbours, and the pattern does the rest.

name: Conway's Game of Life
fact: Four rules, no players, and it can compute anything.

name: Finite state machine
fact: A turnstile, a traffic light, or a vending machine.

name: Pushdown automaton
fact: The stack is what lets it match brackets.

name: Chomsky hierarchy
fact: Four levels, each needing a more powerful machine than the last.

name: Computational complexity
fact: Usually time, sometimes memory, and the two can be traded.

name: Complexity class
fact: Grouping problems by what it would take to solve them.

name: Kolmogorov complexity
fact: A random string is one that cannot be described more briefly than by writing it out.

name: Space complexity
fact: Memory can often be traded for time, and the other way round.

name: Time complexity
fact: Doubling the input may cost twice as much, or a great deal more.

name: The complexity class P
fact: Roughly, the problems a computer can actually settle.

name: Boolean satisfiability problem
fact: It was the first problem proved to be as hard as any in its class.

name: Hardness in the class NP
fact: Solve one of them quickly and you have solved them all.

name: Abstract data type
fact: What it does, not how it does it.

name: Associative array
fact: Look things up by name rather than by position.

name: Queue as a data type
fact: First in, first out, like any orderly line.

name: Hash table
fact: It finds a thing in one step, whatever the size of the table.

name: Linked list
fact: Easy to insert into, and slow to search.

name: Array as a data structure
fact: The position is the address, which is why it is fast.

name: The B tree
fact: It is designed for disks, where reading a block costs the same as reading a byte.

name: Red and black tree
fact: The colours are a bookkeeping trick that keeps it from going lopsided.

name: Sorting algorithm
fact: It was the problem that taught the field how to compare methods.

name: Bubble sort
fact: Everyone is taught it, and nobody should use it.

name: Merge sort
fact: It is steady, predictable, and good for data too big for memory.

name: Quicksort
fact: Fastest in practice, and alarming in its worst case.

name: Binary search tree
fact: It stays fast only while it stays balanced.

name: Mathematical model
fact: All of them are wrong, and some of them are useful.

name: Bijection injection and surjection
fact: One to one, onto, or both.

name: Constant function
fact: Its graph is a flat line, and its derivative is nothing at all.

name: Weierstrass function
fact: It scandalised a generation that had assumed no such thing could exist.

name: Exponential integral
fact: It turns up wherever something decays and you want the running total.

name: Line and line intersection
fact: Parallel, crossing, or the same line twice.

name: Rotations in four dimensional space
fact: A four-dimensional rotation can turn two planes at once, at different rates.

name: Manifold of three dimensions
fact: Classifying them all took a century and a declined prize.

name: Manifold of four dimensions
fact: Four dimensions are the hardest case, harder than higher ones.

name: System of linear equations
fact: No solution, one solution, or infinitely many, and nothing between.

name: Successive over relaxation
fact: Pushing past the correction makes it converge faster.

name: Sporadic group
fact: There are twenty-six of them, and the largest is called the Monster.

name: Hilbert's theorem of zeros
fact: Geometry and algebra turn out to be the same subject.

name: Modularity theorem
fact: Proving a part of it is how Fermat's last theorem was settled.

name: Maximum a posteriori estimation
fact: The most likely answer, once the prior has been taken into account.

name: Bayesian statistics
fact: Start with what you believed, and let the evidence move you.

name: Index in statistics
fact: The cost of living is one, and what goes in the basket is the argument.

name: Maximum likelihood estimation
fact: Pick the explanation under which what happened was least surprising.

name: Expectation maximization algorithm
fact: Guess the missing part, re-estimate, and go round again.

name: Modifiable areal unit problem
fact: Redraw the boundaries and the same data tell a different story.

name: Statistical significance
fact: It says the result is probably not noise; it says nothing about whether it matters.

name: Skolem normal form
fact: It trades a claim that something exists for a name for it.

name: Von Neumann universe
fact: Everything is built from the empty set, one layer at a time.

name: Forcing in mathematics
fact: Cohen invented it to show the continuum hypothesis cannot be decided.

name: Matching polynomial
fact: One polynomial that answers the question for every size at once.

name: Generalized Petersen graph
fact: The original is the smallest and strangest of them.

name: Order theory
fact: Before and after, bigger and smaller, made precise.

name: Stable roommates problem
fact: Unlike the marriage version, it sometimes has no solution at all.

name: Well order
fact: It is what lets induction run past infinity.

name: Ricci calculus
fact: Einstein had to learn it before he could finish general relativity.

name: Solenoidal vector field
fact: Nothing is created and nothing drains away, as with a magnetic field.

name: Numerical methods for ordinary differential equations
fact: Most equations cannot be solved on paper, so they are stepped through instead.

name: Dynamical system simulation
fact: It is how weather, orbits and economies are all studied.

name: Dirichlet series
fact: The zeta function is the first of them.

name: Multipole expansion
fact: From a distance everything looks like a point, then a dipole, then a little more.

name: Extended real number line
fact: It lets limits be written as ordinary values.

name: Rule of false position
fact: Older than algebra, and still perfectly serviceable.

name: Maximum and minimum
fact: Local ones are easy to find, and global ones are not.

name: Saddle point
fact: Flat, and yet not a peak or a trough.

name: Cauchy's integral theorem
fact: Most of complex analysis flows from this one fact.

name: Cauchy Riemann equations
fact: Being differentiable once in the complex plane means being differentiable for ever.

name: Cauchy principal value
fact: Approach the trouble symmetrically from both sides and the infinities cancel.

name: Singularity in mathematics
fact: Where the rules break down, and usually where the interest is.

name: The primality test of Agrawal Kayal and Saxena
fact: It settled a long-open question, and remains too slow to use.

name: Jacobi symbol
fact: It is computed quickly, which is why primality tests use it.

name: Bell number
fact: They grow faster than any exponential.

name: Lucky number
fact: Sieved differently, and they share many properties with the primes.

name: Bezout's identity
fact: It is why the Euclidean algorithm can be run backwards.

name: Dirichlet character
fact: They sort the integers by remainder, and let each class be studied alone.

name: Information set in game theory
fact: It is what makes a card game different from chess.

name: Common knowledge in logic
fact: The crowd knowing the emperor is naked is not the same as each person knowing it.

name: Battle of the sexes in game theory
fact: Agreeing matters more than which thing is agreed.

name: Ellipsoid method
fact: It was the first proof that linear programming is tractable, and it is slow in practice.

name: Karush Kuhn Tucker conditions
fact: They say what must hold at the best point, when some limits may or may not bind.

name: Optimal facility location
fact: Where to put the warehouses, the hospitals or the fire stations.

name: Nondeterministic Turing machine
fact: A useful fiction, since it defines a whole class of problems.

name: Divide and conquer algorithm
fact: Split, solve each part, and stitch the answers together.

name: Cache replacement policies
fact: Guessing what will be wanted next, with no way to know.

name: The complexity class NP
fact: Whether checking quickly implies solving quickly is the great open question.

name: Time hierarchy theorem
fact: Giving a machine more time really does let it solve more.

name: Data model
fact: Deciding what the things are, before deciding how to store them.

name: Heap as a data structure
fact: It gives the largest item instantly, and keeps itself tidy.

name: Outline of physics
fact: The subject everything else eventually reduces to.

name: Fine structure constant
fact: It is close to one over one hundred and thirty-seven, and nobody knows why.

name: Magnetic flux quantum
fact: Magnetism, counted out in indivisible parcels.

name: Auger effect
fact: The energy goes into throwing out another electron instead of into light.

name: Azimuthal quantum number
fact: It is why orbitals are spheres, dumbbells and cloverleaves.

name: Cross section in physics
fact: An effective target area, measured in units named after a barn door.

name: Evanescent field
fact: Light that leaks past the surface without travelling.

name: Type two superconductor
fact: These are the ones that work in strong magnets.

name: Pauli equation
fact: The step between the ordinary quantum equation and the relativistic one.

name: Quantum potential
fact: It makes the theory deterministic, at the cost of being nonlocal.

name: Position operator
fact: Position stops being a number and becomes an operation.

name: Path integral formulation
fact: The particle takes all routes, and the improbable ones cancel out.

name: Fermi's golden rule
fact: It gives the chance per second of a jump.

name: Quantum nonlocality
fact: Bell showed the question could be settled by experiment, and it was.

name: Variational method in quantum mechanics
fact: Guess a shape, compute the energy, and the true answer is never higher.

name: Canonical coordinates
fact: Position and momentum, kept together as partners.

name: Reduced mass
fact: It turns a two-body problem into a one-body problem.

name: Two body problem
fact: Unlike three bodies, two can be solved exactly.

name: Flow measurement
fact: Metering water, gas and oil is most of what it is for.

name: Finite strain theory
fact: Rubber and dough need it; a steel beam usually does not.

name: Fracture toughness
fact: Strong is not the same as tough, and glass proves it.

name: Particle statistics
fact: Whether particles may share a state divides matter from light.

name: Weak isospin
fact: It is the symmetry the weak force acts on.

name: Pressure volume diagram
fact: The area enclosed by the loop is the work done.

name: Thermal conductivity and resistivity
fact: Metals are good at it, and a feather duvet is deliberately bad.

name: Thermodynamic potential
fact: Which one you use depends on what is held fixed.

name: Wien's displacement law
fact: It is why iron glows red, then orange, then white.

name: Quasistatic process
fact: Slow enough that every moment is a state you could describe.

name: Relativistic Doppler effect
fact: Unlike the sound version, it shifts even when the motion is sideways.

name: Optical path
fact: Light takes the path that needs the least time.

name: Snell's law
fact: It is why a straw looks bent in a glass of water.

name: Optical power
fact: It is what the number on a spectacle prescription means.

name: Fresnel equations
fact: They explain why a window is a mirror at a glancing angle.

name: Fourier optics
fact: A lens does a Fourier transform, which is a remarkable thing for glass to do.

name: Audio engineer
fact: Half physics, half taste.

name: Chemical reaction engineering
fact: A reaction that works in a flask may not work in a tank.

name: Green chemistry
fact: Designing the waste out rather than cleaning it up.

name: Precipitation hardening
fact: Tiny particles form inside the metal and block it from slipping.

name: Scientist
fact: The word itself is less than two centuries old.

name: Beaker as laboratory equipment
fact: Its markings are approximate, and never to be trusted for measuring.

name: The weber
fact: One weber changing over one second induces one volt.

name: Five cell
fact: It is the simplest shape that fills four dimensions, as the tetrahedron is in three.

name: Sixteen cell
fact: Eight vertices, twenty four edges and thirty two triangular faces.

name: Twenty four cell
fact: It is named for the octahedra that form its boundary, and it has no counterpart in any other dimension.

name: Modifiable temporal unit problem
fact: Choose days, months or years, and the answer changes with the choice.

name: Push relabel maximum flow algorithm
fact: The name comes from its two basic operations, pushing excess along an edge and relabelling a vertex.

name: Numerical methods for partial differential equations
fact: Hyperbolic, parabolic and elliptic equations each have methods of their own.

name: Strategy
fact: A strategy says what to do in every situation the game can reach.

name: Magnetic quantum number
fact: It distinguishes the orbitals available within a subshell of an atom.

name: Valence and conduction bands
fact: The gap between them decides whether a material conducts, insulates or does both by turns.

name: Schwinger quantum action principle
fact: Julian Schwinger set it out in a series of articles beginning in the middle of the last century.

name: Shearing
fact: It is brought on by a shear stress in the material.

name: Ensemble
fact: Averaging over the copies is how the thermodynamics of one system is found.

name: Weak hypercharge
fact: It is the charge of one of the gauge symmetries that the electroweak theory is built on.

name: Diesel cycle
fact: Fuel is lit by the heat of compressed air rather than by a spark.

name: Redlich Kwong equation of state
fact: Above the critical temperature it beats both the ideal gas law and the equation of van der Waals.

name: Planckian locus
fact: It runs from deep red through orange and white to bluish white.

name: Diffraction limited system
fact: An instrument is called diffraction limited once it has reached that limit and no polishing will help it further.

name: Stokes parameters
fact: George Gabriel Stokes defined them as a convenient alternative to describing partly polarised light by intensity and angle.

name: Demand factor
fact: It is always less than or equal to one.

name: Load following power plant
fact: It sits between the base load plants and the peaking plants in efficiency and in speed of starting.

name: High fructose corn syrup
fact: Corn syrup is made first, and part of its glucose is then turned into fructose.

name: Supung Dam
fact: Its reservoir is among the largest in East Asia, and its power is shared between the two countries.

name: Great Seto Bridge
fact: It carries road above and railway below, and took ten years to build.

name: King Fahd Causeway
fact: Its five bridges rest on hundreds of concrete pylons, with embankments across the shallower water.

name: Physical restraint
fact: Every use of it is a question of necessity and of dignity.

name: Reticle
fact: Crosshairs are the form everyone knows.

name: Fieldnotes
fact: They are read afterwards as evidence, which is why they are written at the time.

name: Globally Harmonized System of Classification of Chemicals
fact: It replaced the assortment of hazard labelling schemes that had grown up around the world.

name: Hazard pictograms
fact: One set is for containers and workplaces, another for the transport of dangerous goods.

name: Fire diamond
fact: Red for fire, blue for health, yellow for reactivity, white for the special warnings.

name: Descriptor
fact: Some of the older ones are no longer recommended.

name: Systematic element name
fact: The name is read straight off the atomic number, and a systematic symbol comes with it.

name: Trivial name
fact: Water, ammonia and vinegar are all trivial names, and none of them is going away.

name: Conversion
fact: Yield asks how much product appeared, and selectivity asks how much of it was the product wanted.

name: Yield
fact: It is one of the first things a synthesis is judged by.

name: Law of reciprocal proportions
fact: It let early chemists fix relative weights without ever seeing an atom.

name: Le Chatelier principle
fact: Press on an equilibrium and it shifts so as to relieve the pressure.

name: Microscopic reversibility
fact: It is why a reaction and its reverse must go by the same path.

name: Congener
fact: The word also covers the minor substances that give a spirit its character.

name: Helium four
fact: Its nucleus is two protons and two neutrons, which is also an alpha particle.

name: Potassium forty
fact: It makes every banana, and every person, faintly radioactive.

name: Radiocaesium
fact: It is what makes fallout linger, since it dissolves readily and behaves in the body like potassium.

name: Carbon twelve
fact: It is the standard against which the atomic masses of all the other nuclides are set.

name: Carbon fourteen
fact: Martin Kamen and Sam Ruben found it in California in the middle of the last century.

name: Cobalt sixty
fact: It is made in reactors by neutron activation, and used to sterilise and to treat.

name: Uranium two thirty eight
fact: It is not fissile, but it can breed plutonium.

name: Uranium two thirty five
fact: It is fissile, which is to say it will sustain a chain reaction.

name: Plutonium two thirty nine
fact: It is bred from uranium in a reactor and does not occur in any quantity in nature.

name: Unbinilium
fact: Its name and symbol are placeholders, read off the number, until somebody makes it.

name: Unbibium
fact: Searches for it have been made and have come back empty.

name: Unbiquadium
fact: It sits in the region where an island of stability is hoped for.

name: Unbihexium
fact: Early calculations made it doubly magic, and it has been hunted ever since.

name: Diphosphane
fact: This colourless liquid is one of several binary hydrides of phosphorus, and it ignites in air.

name: Geminal
fact: A geminal diol carries both of its alcohol groups on one carbon.

name: Vicinal
fact: Vicinal and geminal are the two ways of being neighbours.

name: Oligomer
fact: The name is Greek for a few parts, and it stops where polymer begins.

name: Forever chemicals
fact: Their chemical and thermal stability gives them long lives in the environment, which is why they are called forever chemicals.

name: Hydride
fact: The word is also stretched to cover any compound holding hydrogen bound to something else.

name: Glutamate flavoring
fact: They give food a savoury taste, the one called umami.

name: Nucleophilic substitution
fact: The group that leaves takes the bonding pair with it.

name: Reducing agent
fact: Hydrogen, carbon monoxide and the alkali metals are among the common ones.

name: Phase separation
fact: Oil and water are the example everyone has already seen.

name: Mass transfer
fact: It is the common thread in absorption, evaporation, drying, filtration and distillation.

name: Modern valence bond theory
fact: The rival methods dominated quantum chemistry for decades because they were easier to program.

name: Meso compound
fact: It holds two or more stereocentres and yet is not chiral, because it has an internal mirror.

name: Freezing point depression
fact: Salt on the road and salt in the ice cream churn both work this way.

name: Dissociation constant
fact: It is how tightly a drug holds its target, written as a number.

name: Exothermic reaction
fact: Exothermic reactions usually release their stored energy as heat.

name: Hess law
fact: It lets a heat of reaction be added up from reactions that can actually be measured.

name: Occultation
fact: Timing one as a star winks out behind a body is how the size and the air of that body are measured.

name: Arrokoth
fact: It became the farthest object in the Solar System ever visited by a spacecraft.

name: Oumuamua
fact: Robert Weryk found it with a survey telescope in Hawaii, already on its way out.

name: Comet Borisov
fact: An amateur astronomer found it with a telescope he had made himself.

name: Epsilon Canis Majoris
fact: It was once the brightest star in the whole sky, some four million years ago.

name: Jewel Bug Nebula
fact: It has been given more nicknames than almost any other nebula.

name: Ptolemy Cluster
fact: It is easily seen with the naked eye, close to the sting of the Scorpion, and Ptolemy wrote it down.

name: Kepler Supernova
fact: It is the most recent supernova in our galaxy to have been seen unmistakably with the naked eye.

name: Bode Galaxy
fact: Its clean spiral arms make it the portrait most often used of what a spiral galaxy looks like.

name: Southern Pinwheel Galaxy
fact: Lacaille found it from the Cape of Good Hope, the first galaxy found beyond the Local Group.

name: Local Sheet
fact: We are all drifting together, which is why it counts as one thing.

name: Daylight
fact: It includes the light of the sky itself, and the light bounced back from the ground and from buildings.

name: Scutum
fact: Johannes Hevelius named it for a king, the only constellation named after a person who really lived.

name: Trojan
fact: It rides in one of the two Lagrangian points where the pull of the two bodies balances.

name: Planetary core
fact: Cores may be wholly liquid, or a mixture of solid and liquid as in the Earth.

name: Horizontal branch
fact: Such stars burn helium in the core and hydrogen in a shell around it.

name: Protoplanetary nebula
fact: It shines strongly in the infrared and is lit by reflection.

name: Low surface brightness galaxy
fact: Most are dwarfs, and most of their ordinary matter is neutral hydrogen gas rather than stars.

name: Lacertae object
fact: They vary quickly and by large amounts, and their light is strongly polarised.

name: Observational cosmology
fact: Everything it studies happened long ago, since looking far away is looking back.

name: Multiverse
fact: Together they would hold all of space, time, matter, energy and the physical laws that describe them.

name: Alpher Bethe Gamow paper
fact: Gamow added Bethe to the author list chiefly for the sake of the joke in the names.

name: Discovery of cosmic microwave background
fact: Arno Penzias and Robert Wilson found it as a hiss they could not get rid of, and at first blamed the pigeons.

name: Warm hot intergalactic medium
fact: It is a web of hot thin gas stretched between the galaxies.

name: Visible light astronomy
fact: It is the oldest astronomy there is, and the only kind for all but the last century.

name: Ultraviolet blue visual photometry
fact: It was the first standardised photometric system.

name: Pisces Cetus Supercluster Complex
fact: The Local Group, and so the Milky Way, lies within it.

name: Extraterrestrial vortex
fact: The Great Red Spot of Jupiter has been turning for centuries.

name: Type Ib and Ic supernovae
fact: Unlike the type one a, they show no line of silicon.

name: G Cloud
fact: Whether the Solar System sits in one cloud, the other, or where they meet is still unsettled.

name: Westerhout star cloud
fact: Interstellar gas there forms a diffuse nebula around a cluster of several hundred newborn stars.

name: World
fact: Some hold there is only one, and others talk of many.

name: Low ionization nuclear emission line region
fact: Its light comes from weakly ionised or neutral atoms, and what powers it is still argued over.

name: Artificial life
fact: Christopher Langton gave the field its name.

name: Carbon based life
fact: Carbon is about half of all dry biomass.

name: Non cellular life
fact: Most old definitions of life required cells, and viruses are the reason the definitions moved.

name: Human biology
fact: It is the one branch of biology where the subject reads the result.

name: Earliest known life forms
fact: Carbon fractionated by something living has also been found inside a single grain of zircon in Australia.

name: Neural network
fact: Biological networks are studied to understand how nervous systems are organised and how they work.

name: Organic matter
fact: It is made of the remains and the leavings of plants and animals.

name: Computational biology
fact: It reaches into molecular biology, cell biology, chemistry and genetics.

name: Ethnobiology
fact: What a community knows about its own plants and animals is itself a body of knowledge.

name: Trace fossil
fact: A burrow, a track or a nest can outlast whatever made it.

name: Micropaleontology
fact: The smallest fossils are the ones that date the rock.

name: Paleobotany
fact: It is how the history of plants, and of the air they made, is read.

name: Paleoecology
fact: It borrows from paleontology, ecology, climatology and biology at once.

name: Incertae sedis
fact: It is the honest label for a creature nobody can yet place.

name: Synonym
fact: The botanical and the zoological codes treat synonymy differently.

name: Taxonomic rank
fact: The hierarchy is usually, though not necessarily, built on evolutionary relationships.

name: Order
fact: Carnivora and Primates are orders.

name: Type genus
fact: The name of the family is built from the name of the genus.

name: Type species
fact: It is normally fixed when the genus is first named.

name: Infraspecific name
fact: Subspecies, varieties and forms all live below the species line.

name: Anatomical variation
fact: Variations are sorted by size and shape, by whether a part is present, and by where it lies.

name: Body
fact: Some living things, such as slime moulds, move between being single cells and being one body.

name: Body fluid
fact: In a lean healthy adult, water is about three fifths of the whole body weight.

name: Extracellular fluid
fact: It is the sea that every cell still lives in.

name: Digit
fact: The bones in them are among the first things a fossil hunter counts.

name: Peritoneum
fact: It covers most of the organs within that cavity.

name: Abdominal cavity
fact: It is part of the larger cavity that runs down to the pelvis.

name: Flipper
fact: It is the fully webbed swimming limb of aquatic vertebrates that are not fish.

name: Webbed foot
fact: It has evolved over and over, independently, in group after group.

name: Torso
fact: In a four limbed animal it divides into chest and belly.

name: Arteriole
fact: Its muscular walls are the main place where the body sets its own blood pressure.

name: Venule
fact: The smallest of them are finer than a hair.

name: Lymphatic vessel
fact: As part of the lymphatic system they are the complement of the circulation of the blood.

name: Cephalopod beak
fact: The upper part fits into the lower, and the two work like scissors.

name: Vocal sac
fact: It works as an amplifier for the call.

name: Eosinophil
fact: They also sit behind much of what happens in an allergy.

name: Basophil
fact: They carry the granules that release histamine.

name: Outer ear
fact: It gathers the energy of sound and focuses it on the eardrum.

name: Bitterness
fact: Coffee, beer and chocolate are all built on it.

name: Bitter taste evolution
fact: The cluster of those genes is vast in land vertebrates and varies greatly from species to species.

name: Pungency
fact: It is not a taste at all but a signal on the nerves that report pain and warmth.

name: Saltiness
fact: The first reads as delicious and the second as too much.

name: Sourness
fact: It is a warning sign for food that has spoiled, and a balance in food that has not.

name: Sweetness
fact: Sweet tastes are generally regarded as pleasurable, which is the whole trouble.

name: Nostril
fact: Some animals smell in stereo, one nostril at a time.

name: Eye colour
fact: Blue eyes hold no blue pigment at all.

name: Monochromacy
fact: Such an eye sees only shades of grey.

name: Dichromacy
fact: Most mammals see the world this way.

name: Tetrachromacy
fact: Many birds and insects have it, and a few people may.

name: Purkinje effect
fact: Reds go dark first at dusk, which is why poppies vanish before the leaves do.

name: Udder
fact: Almost every dairy on Earth is built around it.

name: Carpal bones
fact: The words carpus and carpal come from the Greek for wrist.

name: Hyoid bone
fact: It touches no other bone, which is part of why we can speak.

name: Metacarpal bones
fact: They answer to the bones of the middle of the foot.

name: Metatarsal bones
fact: They have no individual names, only numbers from the side of the great toe.

name: Patella
fact: Mice, cats, birds, humans and dogs have one; whales do not.

name: Phalanx bone
fact: In primates the thumb and the great toe have two each and every other digit has three.

name: Intervertebral disc
fact: It allows a little movement, holds the vertebrae together, and takes the shock.

name: Mollusc shell
fact: Snails, clams and tusk shells each take the same material a different way.

name: Adipocyte
fact: They grow from the same stem cells that make bone and cartilage.

name: Fibroblast
fact: It is the commonest cell of connective tissue, and the one that closes a wound.

name: Basement membrane
fact: It is a very thin, flexible, strong sheet that every epithelium sits on.

name: Bird anatomy
fact: A light skeleton, powerful muscle and a circulation built for high rates of work all serve the same end.

name: Fish anatomy
fact: It is the counterpart of fish physiology, which asks how the parts work together in the living animal.

name: Plant nutrition
fact: Without one of them the plant cannot finish a normal life.

name: Hypocotyl
fact: Its name means the part below the seed leaf.

name: Radicle
fact: The root goes down before the shoot goes up.

name: Tumbleweed
fact: Rolling is how it sows.

name: Herbaceous plant
fact: Most annuals and biennials, and many perennials, belong here.

name: Liana
fact: It is not a group in the family tree but a way of growing.

name: Tendril
fact: Sweet peas, passionflowers and grapes all climb this way.

name: Branch
fact: The same word does for a tree and for its leaf.

name: Cortex
fact: It is mostly large thin walled cells with little structure of their own.

name: Strobilus
fact: Strobili are often called cones, though some would keep that word for the woody ones of the conifers.

name: Endodermis
fact: A waterproof band in their walls forces every drop to pass through a cell to get in.

name: Conidium
fact: The word comes from the ancient Greek for dust.

name: Plant physiology
fact: It asks what the plant is doing, where anatomy asks what it is made of.

name: Vegetative reproduction
fact: Every potato in a field may be one plant.

name: Protocarnivorous plant
fact: It is the halfway house on the road to a carnivorous plant.

name: Blinking
fact: One blink is the letting go of one muscle and the firing of another.

name: Regurgitation
fact: For a bird feeding its young it is not an illness but a method.

name: Belching
fact: In humans it can come from ordinary eating or from something gone wrong.

name: Flatulence
fact: The word flatus is the medical term for gas made in the stomach or the bowels.

name: Acid base homeostasis
fact: The balance has to hold, or no cell can go on working.

name: Warm blooded
fact: Birds and mammals keep theirs steady by setting the pace of their own chemistry.

name: Eurytherm
fact: Every stage of its life, larva and young included, must manage it to count.

name: Poikilotherm
fact: It does not make its own heat so much as borrow the weather.

name: Mesotherm
fact: Tuna and some turtles are in this middle country.

name: Homeothermy
fact: It costs food, and it buys a body that works the same at dawn as at noon.

name: Stenotherm
fact: It is the specialism of the deep sea and the poles, where the world holds still.

name: Kleptothermy
fact: It may be mutual or it may be theft, and it happens in warm and cold blooded alike.

name: Bradymetabolism
fact: Such animals can change the speed of their chemistry dramatically as food and warmth allow.

name: Gigantothermy
fact: Less surface for the bulk means heat is slower to leave, which is how a large reptile keeps warm.

name: Aestivation
fact: It is entered against heat and dryness, and the metabolism slows to meet them.

name: Embryology
fact: It is the parent discipline of developmental biology.

name: Offspring
fact: Taken together they may be called a brood or a progeny.

name: Germline
fact: It is the only line of cells whose changes are handed on.

name: Yolk
fact: Its work is to feed the embryo until the embryo can feed itself.

name: Pregnancy in fish
fact: The seahorse carries its brood in the male.

name: Animal embryonic development
fact: Every animal passes through it, and the early stages look oddly alike.

name: Blastulation
fact: In mammals it goes on to form a hollow ball with an inner mass of cells and an outer wall.

name: Multiple birth
fact: It happens in most kinds of mammal, at very different rates.

name: Preterm birth
fact: The earlier it comes, the more the child depends on the care that meets it.

name: Plant embryonic development
fact: Dormancy and then germination follow it.

name: Antheridium
fact: Mosses and ferns still carry them.

name: Archegonium
fact: Its name is from the Greek for beginning and offspring.

name: Oogonium
fact: It is where the egg begins.

name: Structural biology
fact: For a long time it could reach no further than what a lens could show.

name: Biopolymer
fact: Like other polymers they are chains of single units bonded together.

name: Antioxidant
fact: They are added to fuels, polymers and lubricants for the same reason the body makes its own.

name: Lutein
fact: Only plants make it, and it gathers in green leaves and in the eye.

name: Monosaccharide
fact: Every larger sugar is built from them.

name: Glyceraldehyde
fact: It is the simplest of all the common sugars, and the one the others are compared with.

name: Disaccharide
fact: Table sugar, milk sugar and malt sugar are all of this kind.

name: Polysaccharide
fact: They are the most abundant carbohydrates in food.

name: Dietary fibre
fact: Fibres differ in how they dissolve, how they thicken and whether the gut flora will ferment them.

name: Glutathione
fact: It is the antioxidant that plants, animals, fungi and some bacteria all keep on hand.

name: Androgen
fact: It works by binding to its own receptor in the cell.

name: Ghrelin
fact: Its level in the blood is highest before a meal and falls after one.

name: Glucocorticoid
fact: Their receptor sits in almost every cell of every vertebrate.

name: Leptin
fact: Its likely role is to keep the long run balance of energy, telling the brain how much fat is in store.

name: Progestogen
fact: Progesterone is the chief one in the body.

name: Secretin
fact: It was the first hormone ever identified.

name: Catecholamine
fact: Adrenaline, noradrenaline and dopamine are the three the body makes.

name: Brassinosteroid
fact: They govern how a plant stretches and how it meets a cold night.

name: Florigen
fact: The signal is made in the leaf and travels to the tip of the shoot.

name: Jasmonate
fact: They are what a plant sends round itself when something starts eating it.

name: Strigolactone
fact: They are read both by helpful fungi and by the parasites that hunt roots.

name: Omega three fatty acid
fact: They are widely distributed in nature and are important parts of animal fats.

name: Omega six fatty acid
fact: The body cannot make them, so they have to be eaten.

name: Malacology
fact: The name is from the Greek for soft.

name: Animal cognition
fact: The study of conditioning and learning used in the field grew out of comparative psychology.

name: Animal consciousness
fact: Sentience, subjectivity, the ability to feel: the words are as hard as the question.

name: Sleep in animals
fact: It has now been found even in jellyfish and sponges, which have no brain to rest.

name: Siesta
fact: It goes by its Spanish name wherever the afternoon is hot.

name: Wakefulness
fact: It is the opposite of sleep, in which most of what reaches the brain is kept out of its reckoning.

name: Yawn
fact: Fish and birds do it too, and nobody is sure why any of us do.

name: Imprinting
fact: A gosling learns what to follow, and will follow it thereafter.

name: Personal grooming
fact: It is a behaviour typical of a species, and in many of them it is also how company is kept.

name: Maternity den
fact: It is usually underground, but it may be a cave in the snow or simply the space under a ledge.

name: Mating
fact: In most species it takes two, though a hermaphrodite may manage alone.

name: Fight or flight response
fact: Walter Cannon first described it, and freezing belongs to it too.

name: Flock
fact: Flocks are typically associated with migration.

name: Shoaling and schooling
fact: In common use the two words are run together, but to a biologist they are not the same.

name: Bird vocalisation
fact: Songs are the complex utterances, calls the simple ones, and the difference is of function, not of beauty.

name: Hematophagy
fact: Blood is a fluid tissue rich in protein and fat that can be taken without great effort, which is why so many small animals take it.

name: Hypercarnivore
fact: What is left of the diet may be fungi, fruit or other plant matter.

name: Insectivore
fact: People who do it have a word of their own.

name: Browsing
fact: It is the opposite of grazing, which keeps to the grass.

name: Hypocarnivore
fact: The grizzly, the black bear and the kinkajou all live this way.

name: Mesocarnivore
fact: They are mostly small to medium sized mammals, and they do well near people.

name: Aquatic locomotion
fact: It has evolved separately again and again, in arthropods, fish, molluscs, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals.

name: Arboreal locomotion
fact: Some animals climb only now and then; others never come down.

name: Facultative bipedalism
fact: A lizard sprinting on two legs is doing it.

name: Quadrupedalism
fact: The word is Latin for four footed.

name: Terrestrial locomotion
fact: It matters to the study of evolution because the first land animals had to invent it.

name: Tripedalism
fact: Bilateral symmetry settled in very early, before there were limbs at all to be counted.

name: Flying and gliding animals
fact: Each has appendages that work the air for lift enough to carry its own weight and whatever it is carrying.

name: Burrow
fact: Burrows are found in nearly every biome, and they shelter against both weather and teeth.

name: Nest
fact: Birds are not the only builders; every class of vertebrate has some, and so do many invertebrates.

name: Antibiotic sensitivity testing
fact: It is needed because bacteria may be resistant to some of them.

name: Cell death
fact: It may be the ordinary replacement of old cells, or the result of injury or disease.

name: Protein targeting
fact: A protein may be addressed to an organelle, to a membrane, or to the world beyond the cell.

name: Facilitated diffusion
fact: Nothing is spent; the molecule simply goes the way it was already going, through a door.

name: Biochemical cascade
fact: Each step amplifies the last, so a faint signal outside becomes a loud one within.

name: Second messenger system
fact: The first messenger never has to come in.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell
fact: The process is called haematopoiesis, and it goes on in the marrow all your life.

name: Cell junction
fact: They also keep the seal that stops things leaking between the cells of a sheet.

name: Biological membrane
fact: Everything alive keeps an inside, and this is how.

name: Membrane potential
fact: Every nerve impulse is this difference, briefly undone.

name: Membrane protein
fact: They fall into broad kinds according to where in the membrane they sit.

name: Endomembrane system
fact: They divide the cell into compartments, each with work of its own.

name: Plastid deoxyribonucleic acid
fact: A chloroplast keeps its own small genome, a relic of the bacterium it once was.

name: Plasmodesma
fact: A plant is walled off cell from cell, and these are the doors.

name: Autotroph
fact: Everything else eats what an autotroph made.

name: Biogeographic realm
fact: Realms divide into bioregions and those into ecoregions.

name: Disturbance
fact: Disturbances act fast and hard, and many communities are built around expecting them.

name: Niche construction
fact: The beaver does not merely live in a pond; it makes one.

name: Ecosystem model
fact: It may cover a single population or a whole biome.

name: Energy flow
fact: Producers and consumers make a chain, and most of the energy is lost at every step of it.

name: Insular biogeography
fact: It was first worked out for real islands, and then found to fit every patch of habitat cut off from the rest.

name: Lotka Volterra equations
fact: Predator and prey rise and fall, each a little behind the other, forever.

name: Selection for many or for few
fact: Many young and little care, or few young and much: both are ways of staying in the world.

name: Biological interaction
fact: They may be of the same species or of different ones.

name: Ecosystem collapse
fact: Processes that steady it and processes that unsettle it are both always at work.

name: Habitat fragmentation
fact: A wood cut in two by a road is not two woods.

name: Ecological restoration
fact: It differs from conservation in setting out to mend what is already broken rather than to prevent the breaking.

name: Wildlife
fact: The word once meant only the birds and beasts that were hunted.

name: Enhancer
fact: Those proteins are called transcription factors.

name: Post transcriptional modification
fact: Only then can it leave the nucleus and do its work.

name: Post translational modification
fact: Most are reversible, and that is how the amount of working protein is controlled.

name: Non coding ribonucleic acid
fact: The stretch of the genome it is copied from is called an acid gene rather than a protein gene.

name: Expression vector
fact: It carries a chosen gene into a cell and borrows the machinery there to make the protein.

name: Penetrance
fact: A variant may be carried and never show, which is why family trees mislead.

name: Sex determination system
fact: Chromosomes do it in some species and the temperature of the nest does it in others.

name: Extranuclear inheritance
fact: Mitochondria and chloroplasts carry their own, and they usually come from one parent only.

name: Genetic recombination
fact: It is what makes a child unlike either parent and unlike any sibling.

name: Homologous recombination
fact: It is also the cell's way of mending a break in both strands at once.

name: Quantitative genetics
fact: Many genes make a smooth range where one gene would make a sharp division.

name: Heritability
fact: It is a statement about a population, never about a person.

name: Reverse genetics
fact: Classical genetics went the other way, from the visible trait back to the gene.

name: Molecular genetics
fact: It works by breaking something on purpose and watching what fails.

name: Molecular evolution
fact: It is the basis of every attempt to draw the tree of life from sequences.

name: Epigenomics
fact: It stands to the epigenome as genomics stands to the genome.

name: Epigenome
fact: Some of those changes are passed on to the next generation.

name: Heterosis
fact: Mixing what the parents brought can make a plant that outgrows them both.

name: Evolutionary biology
fact: Darwin and Wallace found the first of the four independently.

name: Evolution of sexual reproduction
fact: Why sex is worth its cost is still among the oldest open questions in biology.

name: Viral evolution
fact: Generations are short and mutation is frequent, so a virus can change while you watch.

name: Genetic admixture
fact: It happens between species as hybrids, and within a species whenever people move.

name: Haplogroup
fact: Because they travel together they can be traced back, which is how deep ancestry is read.

name: Nucleic acid structure
fact: The two of them are chemically very similar, and the difference is one oxygen.

name: Glycated haemoglobin
fact: Sugars in the blood join it without an enzyme, so the amount of it records the months just past.

name: Protein biosynthesis
fact: Proteins work as enzymes, as structure and as hormones, and all of them wear out.

name: Protein structure
fact: The sequence is written by the gene; the shape it folds into is what does the work.

name: Proteome
fact: The genome is fixed; the proteome changes by the hour.

name: Proteinogenic amino acid
fact: The word means protein creating, and there are only a score or so of them.

name: Steroid hormone
fact: They divide into the corticosteroids made in the adrenal cortex and the sex steroids made in the gonads or the placenta.

name: Biosynthesis
fact: It usually means a sequence of steps, each driven by its own enzyme, building something more complex than what went in.

name: Catabolism
fact: It is the half of metabolism that takes things apart.

name: Gluconeogenesis
fact: Plants, animals, fungi and bacteria all do it, because the brain and the blood will not wait.

name: Metabolomics
fact: It reads the chemical fingerprints that a process leaves behind.

name: Secondary metabolite
fact: Most medicines, poisons, dyes and scents began as one.

name: Oxidative phosphorylation
fact: In organisms with a nucleus it happens inside the mitochondria.

name: Photosystem
fact: Between them they do the first chemistry of the whole business, catching light and passing on energy and electrons.

name: Biological carbon fixation
fact: Those compounds then store the energy and build the body.

name: Carbon fixation by three carbons
fact: Most plants on Earth use it, and it falters in heat and drought.

name: Carbon fixation by four carbons
fact: Hatch and Slack found it, and maize, sugar cane and many tropical grasses use it to beat the heat.

name: Crown group
fact: It is a way of defining a branch of the tree that starts from what is still alive.

name: Thallus
fact: It usually names the whole body of an organism that has no root, stem or leaf to divide it.

name: Accommodation
fact: Between the far point and the near point everything can be made sharp, and the span narrows with age.

name: Primary vein
fact: It carries the traffic and holds the leaf out flat.

name: Healing
fact: Medicine takes part, but the mending is done by the cells themselves.

name: Gamete
fact: Eduard Strasburger gave it the name.

name: Evolutionary history of plants
fact: Every step of it changed the air as well as the ground.

name: Bryopsida
fact: Some eleven thousand species of them grow the world over.

name: Polysporangiophyte
fact: The name means, literally, many spore case plant.

name: Rhyniophyte
fact: Sources differ over what to call the group and at what rank.

name: Cooksonia
fact: It is among the first plants known to have stood up on land.

name: Progymnosperm
fact: Wood came before seed, and these are the proof of it.

name: Archaeopteris
fact: It is a useful index fossil, and it made the first forests.

name: Isoetes
fact: It is the only living genus of its family and its order.

name: Lepidodendron
fact: Its name is Greek for scale tree, after the pattern its fallen leaves left on the trunk.

name: Lycopodiaceae
fact: The family began in the early Devonian and is with us still.

name: Lycopodium powder
fact: Mixed with air the spores are highly flammable, and the theatre has used them for flame effects.

name: Selaginella
fact: Some of them curl up dry and open again when the rain comes.

name: Zosterophyll
fact: They are one of the two great lines of the early land flora.

name: Leptosporangiate fern
fact: Some eleven thousand species belong to it.

name: Aspleniaceae
fact: The make up and the classification of the family have changed a good deal.

name: Dryopteridaceae
fact: They are the ferns of the forest floor.

name: Lygodium
fact: It is the only genus in its family, and its leaf goes on growing like a vine.

name: Salviniales
fact: One of them lives with a cyanobacterium and so fertilises the rice paddy it floats on.

name: Cyatheales
fact: No single feature of their form marks them all out, but the sequences say they are one branch.

name: Marattiaceae
fact: Their kin were giants of the coal forests.

name: Seed plant
fact: The name is Greek for seed plant, and the invention was the making of the modern flora.

name: Pteridosperm
fact: The earliest of them are of late Devonian age.

name: Bennettitales
fact: They were among the commonest seed plants of their age, and some bore flowerlike cones.

name: Araucariaceae
fact: Native now almost only to the southern hemisphere, it was spread across the north in the age of the dinosaurs.

name: Podocarpaceae
fact: Many carry their seed on a fleshy stalk that birds take for fruit.

name: Sciadopitys
fact: It is the sole living genus of its family, with no close relative anywhere.

name: Taxaceae
fact: Its members carry a seed in a red cup instead of a cone.

name: Pacific yew
fact: A cancer drug was first drawn from its bark.

name: Cupressaceae
fact: The tallest trees on Earth belong to it.

name: Cryptomeria
fact: It is the national tree of Japan, and it has been planted there for a very long time.

name: Common juniper
fact: It has the largest range of any woody plant on Earth, and it flavours gin.

name: Pinaceae
fact: Most of the timber of the northern world comes from it.

name: Bristlecone pine
fact: Some of them were already old when the pyramids were new.

name: Old Tjikko
fact: The visible tree is young; the root it grows from is thousands of years old.

name: Dicotyledon
fact: The name says it: the seed has two first leaves.

name: Nymphaea
fact: It is found almost everywhere there is still fresh water.

name: Victoria
fact: Its leaves are remarkable, growing wide enough to bear a child.

name: Magnoliaceae
fact: It holds the magnolias and the tulip trees, and it is older than the bees.

name: Piper
fact: Black pepper and the betel leaf are both in it.

name: Palmyra palm
fact: It is a tall sturdy tree with a crown of great fan shaped leaves, and sugar is drawn from its flower stalk.

name: Talipot palm
fact: It flowers once, enormously, and then dies, and its leaves were written on for centuries.

name: Phytelephas
fact: They are called the ivory palms, because the seed is hard and white enough to carve.

name: Royal palm
fact: It has been planted along avenues throughout the tropics.

name: Saw palmetto
fact: It spreads sideways instead, and a single clump may be very old.

name: Asparagaceae
fact: The family is named after the garden asparagus.

name: Allium
fact: The onion, the garlic, the leek and the chive are all in it.

name: Dracaena
fact: One of them bleeds a red resin that was traded as dragon's blood.

name: Moth orchid
fact: It is widely grown as a houseplant, and few plants are sold in greater numbers.

name: Grass tree
fact: Fire does not kill them; it is what makes them flower.

name: Tradescantia
fact: Its large cells made it a favourite for looking at chromosomes down a microscope.

name: Pandanaceae
fact: Their stilt roots hold them upright on sand, and their leaves are woven and cooked with.

name: Carex
fact: Sedges have edges, as the old rhyme has it.

name: Bulrush
fact: Nearly every part of it has been eaten, woven or burned.

name: Cynodon
fact: Its name is Greek for dog tooth, and it makes the lawns and the pitches of the warm world.

name: Oryza
fact: Its members are tall wetland grasses, and more people live on them than on anything else.

name: Musa acuminata
fact: Most of the sweet bananas eaten today come from it, some by crossing with its wild cousin.

name: Saba banana
fact: It is first of all a cooking banana, though it can be eaten raw.

name: Traveller tree
fact: Its leaves stand in one flat fan, and travellers have drunk the water caught at their bases.

name: Zingiberaceae
fact: They are aromatic perennial herbs with creeping rootstocks, and the spice shelf owes them a great deal.

name: Taraxacum
fact: They set seed without pollination, so a lawn full of them may be one plant over and over.

name: Brassica rapa
fact: The turnip, the pak choi and the field mustard are all forms of the one species.

name: Beta vulgaris
fact: Chard, beetroot, mangold and the sugar beet are all the same plant, bred four ways.

name: Japanese knotweed
fact: It comes up through tarmac, and in some countries it must be declared when a house is sold.

name: Bougainvillea
fact: The colour everyone admires is not in the flower but in the leaves around it.

name: Opuntia
fact: It was tamed in central Mexico thousands of years ago.

name: Hydrangea
fact: Some of them turn blue in sour soil and pink in sweet, which makes the shrub a kind of meter.

name: Bitter melon
fact: It is as bitter as its name, and it is taken as a medicine as much as a food.

name: Winter squash
fact: Unlike the summer squash it is picked ripe, and it will last the winter out.

name: Honeysuckle
fact: The genus runs right round the northern world, and the scent is the point of the flower.

name: Sambucus
fact: The flowers and the ripe fruit are used, and the rest of the plant is best left alone.

name: Evolution of fungi
fact: They are closer kin to animals than to plants.

name: Aspergillus
fact: An Italian priest first catalogued it, and it ferments soy sauce and sake to this day.

name: Neurospora crassa
fact: Its name means nerve spore, after the striations on the spores, and genetics learned much of its grammar from it.

name: Fungi imperfecti
fact: They are a waiting room rather than a branch of the family tree.

name: Glomeromycota
fact: Its members make the arbuscular mycorrhizas that most land plants depend on.

name: Dimorphic fungus
fact: The switch is usually brought on by a change in temperature, which is why it matters in disease.

name: Microsporidia
fact: Their spores hold a coiled tube that fires out and injects the cell they land on.

name: Rhizopus
fact: It is the black mould of a forgotten loaf, and it also makes tempeh.

name: Fission yeast
fact: Its cells are rod shaped and split across the middle, which makes the cell cycle easy to watch.

name: Edible mushroom
fact: Properly identified is doing a great deal of work in that sentence.

name: Pleurotus
fact: They are among the most widely grown edible mushrooms, and they will fruit on straw or sawdust.

name: Straw mushroom
fact: It is raised on beds of spent rice straw, and it does not keep, so most of the world meets it in a tin.

name: Cordyceps
fact: Chinese medicine has used them for a very long time, and some of them take over the behaviour of the insect they infect.

name: Ergot
fact: The one on rye has poisoned whole districts, and medicine has drawn useful drugs from the same source.

name: Lecanorales
fact: The order holds thousands of species, most of the crusts on the rocks and walls among them.

name: Parmeliaceae
fact: Most of the leafy grey lichens on a tree trunk are in it.

name: Iceland moss
fact: It has been boiled for food in hard years.

name: Oakmoss
fact: Perfumery has long used it for the deep note at the base of a scent.

name: Usnea
fact: It hangs in beards from branches, and it carries an acid that works against bacteria.

name: Reindeer lichen
fact: Whole herds winter on it, and it grows back very slowly.

name: Lungwort lichen
fact: Three kingdoms in one organism, and it will not live where the air is foul.

name: Myxogastria
fact: They are colloquially called the plasmodial slime moulds, and one body may creep about as a single great cell.

name: Dictyostelium
fact: When food runs out the separate cells gather into one body, and some of them die to lift the rest.

name: Euglenid
fact: Many of them feed by light like a plant and by hunting like an animal, as the mood takes them.

name: Kinetoplastid
fact: Several of them cause grave diseases in people and in cattle.

name: Archaeplastida
fact: All of them descend from the one cell that first took a cyanobacterium inside.

name: Glaucophyte
fact: Their chloroplasts still keep a wall, like the bacterium they came from.

name: Porphyra
fact: It is the laver of Wales and the nori of Japan.

name: Spirogyra
fact: It is the bright green blanket weed of a still pond.

name: Chlamydomonas
fact: It is a model organism for the study of how a cell swims and how a chloroplast works.

name: Chlorella
fact: The cells are spheres a few thousandths of a millimetre across, and they are grown in tanks for protein.

name: Coccolithophore
fact: They wrap themselves in chalk plates, and the white cliffs are made of what they left.

name: Laminaria
fact: Its long leathery blades make the underwater forests of cold coasts.

name: Fucus
fact: It is the bladderwrack that pops underfoot at low tide.

name: Golden algae
fact: They should not be confused with another, vaguer group of a similar name.

name: Asgard archaea
fact: It appears that animals, plants, fungi and protists all emerged from within this group.

name: Methanobacterium
fact: Despite the name it is not a bacterium at all, and its cell wall shows as much.

name: Halobacterium
fact: It is coloured by a pigment close kin to the one in the eye, and it uses light the same way.

name: Thermoplasma
fact: They can breathe sulfur, and they have no cell wall at all.

name: Sulfolobus
fact: It lives in hot acid springs, and molecular biology borrowed its enzymes.

name: Evolution of bacteria
fact: The story was read out of their genes rather than out of rocks.

name: Gram negative bacteria
fact: What sets them apart is a thin wall held between two membranes.

name: Anabaena
fact: They fix nitrogen, and some of them live inside a floating fern that fertilises a rice field.

name: Aliivibrio fischeri
fact: It glows, and a squid keeps it in an organ to hide its own shadow from below.

name: Haemophilus influenzae
fact: It was wrongly blamed for influenza, and it was the first free living organism to have its genome read out in full.

name: Klebsiella pneumoniae
fact: It is among the worst of the hospital infections, because it so readily picks up resistance.

name: Legionella pneumophila
fact: It lives inside freshwater amoebae, and a cooling tower suits it just as well.

name: Rhizobia
fact: They cannot do it alone; they need the plant to switch the work on.

name: Borrelia
fact: Several species cause Lyme disease, carried by ticks, and others cause a fever that comes back again and again.

name: Corynebacterium
fact: They are rods, club shaped at some stages of life, which is what gave the genus its name.

name: Mycobacterium
fact: Tuberculosis and leprosy are both in it, and the waxy coat is what makes them so hard to kill.

name: Lactobacillus
fact: They sour milk and cabbage and dough, and the gut is the better for them.

name: Staphylococcus
fact: Under the microscope they are spheres in clusters, and the name is Greek for a bunch of grapes.

name: Virus latency
fact: A latent infection is not the same thing as a chronic one; it waits rather than works.

name: Orthomyxoviridae
fact: Four of them cause influenza in birds and in mammals.

name: Influenza B virus
fact: It is known to infect only certain mammals, humans, ferrets, pigs and seals among them.

name: Respiratory syncytial virus
fact: Almost every child meets it, and for the smallest it is the commonest reason to be taken into hospital.

name: First aid kit
fact: What goes in it depends on what is likely to go wrong where it is kept.

name: Medical device
fact: In countries around the world it must be shown to be safe and to work before it may be sold.

name: Medical emergency
fact: The old phrase for it is a risk to life or limb.

name: Medicalisation
fact: New evidence can drive it, and so can changing attitudes or the prospect of money.

name: Healthcare industry
fact: It covers care that cures, care that prevents, care that rehabilitates and care that comforts.

name: Search and rescue
fact: The field divides by the ground it must cross, from mountain to sea to cave.

name: Triage
fact: The aim is that help goes where it does the most good.

name: Universal health care
fact: It is often confused with a single payer system, but there is more than one road to it.

name: White coat
fact: It protects the clothes underneath and serves as a plain uniform.

name: Health professional
fact: The title covers everyone from the surgeon to the community health worker.

name: Allied health professions
fact: There is no one international standard for which professions belong.

name: Emergency medical technician
fact: They are most often found on ambulances and in fire brigades.

name: Midwifery
fact: It is among the oldest callings there is.

name: General practitioner
fact: The skill lies in caring for the whole person, and in living with the uncertainty that comes of seeing everything first.

name: Surgeon
fact: A modern surgeon takes the same training as any physician before going on to specialise.

name: Health facility
fact: They range from a small clinic to a great hospital with its own trauma centre.

name: Clinic
fact: It may be privately run or publicly funded.

name: Doctor office
fact: It is usually where a general practitioner works.

name: Intensive care unit
fact: It is where the machines that stand in for failing organs are kept.

name: Trauma centre
fact: How long it takes to reach one is often the whole of the matter.

name: Human anatomy
fact: It divides into what the eye can see and what needs a microscope.

name: Cadaver
fact: Students dissect one as part of their education, and it is usually given by the person themselves.

name: Human variability
fact: The disputed areas are the familiar ones: ability, personality, appearance.

name: Coeliac plexus
fact: It lies behind the stomach, where the great arteries branch from the aorta.

name: Human head
fact: It houses the brain, and the skull that protects it also frames the eyes and the nose.

name: Scalp
fact: It is skin, layers of connective and fibrous tissue, and the membrane over the bone.

name: Forehead
fact: Its top is marked by the hairline.

name: Brow ridge
fact: In humans the eyebrows sit along its lower margin, and in our older relatives it was far heavier.

name: Facial skeleton
fact: The rest of the skull is the braincase.

name: Human mouth
fact: Its lining is a mucous membrane, and it begins both eating and speech.

name: Human tooth
fact: They are counted as part of the digestive system.

name: Root canal
fact: It holds the pulp, and the branching side canals that run off it are what make the dentist's work difficult.

name: Uvula
fact: It is connective tissue, glands and some muscle fibres, and it helps shut the nose off when you swallow.

name: Chin
fact: A fully developed human skull has one; no other animal does.

name: Human hair colour
fact: Generally, the more melanin there is, the darker the hair.

name: Anterior cruciate ligament
fact: The two are called cruciate because they cross, and tearing this one ends many a sporting career.

name: Latissimus dorsi muscle
fact: Its name is Latin for the broadest muscle of the back, and it is what pulls the arm down.

name: Shoulder
fact: The joints between them make it the most mobile joint in the body, and the least stable.

name: Deltoid muscle
fact: Its name comes from the Greek letter it is shaped like.

name: Pelvic floor
fact: It runs from the pubic bone at the front to the tailbone at the back, and it carries everything above it.

name: Rectus abdominis muscle
fact: The segments are what show as the familiar blocks when the covering fat is thin.

name: Human skin
fact: Up to seven layers of tissue guard the muscles, bones, ligaments and organs beneath.

name: Human skin colour
fact: The differences are largely inherited, with the sun doing the rest.

name: Wrinkle
fact: In skin they come with age, with habitual sleeping positions, with the sun, and briefly with a long bath.

name: Biceps
fact: Both its heads arise on the shoulder blade and join in one belly attached to the forearm.

name: Thumb
fact: Its opposition to the others is what makes the hand a tool.

name: Index finger
fact: It has more names than any other, most of them earned by pointing.

name: Middle finger
fact: It is usually the longest.

name: Ring finger
fact: The custom of the ring on it is older than any explanation offered for it.

name: Little finger
fact: It carries far more of the grip than its size suggests.

name: Handedness
fact: Most people favour the right, and nobody is quite sure why.

name: Hip
fact: It carries the weight of the whole body above it, on two legs.

name: Gluteus maximus
fact: It is the largest and outermost of the three gluteal muscles, and it is why we can run.

name: Hamstring
fact: Sprinters tear them more often than anyone.

name: Thigh
fact: It holds the longest and strongest bone in the body.

name: Medical specialty
fact: Some are defined by an age, some by an organ, some by a method.
