name: Anaesthesiology
fact: It takes in anaesthesia, intensive care, emergency medicine and the medicine of pain.

name: Angiology
fact: In the United States the same field is more often called vascular medicine.

name: Audiology
fact: Audiologists treat hearing loss and work to prevent more of it.

name: Clinical neuroscience
fact: It aims at new ways of understanding, of diagnosing and at last of treating them.

name: Endocrinology
fact: A gland that speaks too loudly or too softly can change a whole life.

name: Emergency medicine
fact: Its physicians take whoever comes through the door, of any age and with anything at all.

name: Family medicine
fact: The point of it is the long acquaintance.

name: Hepatology
fact: It was long a part of gastroenterology, and in some countries it has grown into a field of its own.

name: Internal medicine
fact: Internal here means the treatment of the diseases of the internal organs.

name: Acute medicine
fact: It grew up in the United Kingdom as a dedicated field in this century.

name: Intensive care medicine
fact: It takes in life support, invasive monitoring, resuscitation and the care of the dying.

name: Life extension
fact: That limit is somewhere around a hundred and twenty five years.

name: Supercentenarian
fact: Only about one centenarian in a thousand gets there.

name: Medical genetics
fact: It differs from human genetics in being applied: the knowledge is put to use in care.

name: Medical microbiology
fact: It also studies the useful things that microbes can be made to do.

name: Nephrology
fact: It runs from diet and medicine all the way to the dialysis machine.

name: Nuclear medicine
fact: It is radiology turned inside out, recording radiation from within the body rather than passing it through.

name: Occupational medicine
fact: Its physicians are trained in clinical medicine and in public health alike.

name: Orthopaedic surgery
fact: Its surgeons use surgical and other means alike, on trauma, on the spine, on sporting injuries and on the wear of years.

name: Orthotics
fact: An orthosis is a device applied from outside to change how the muscles and the skeleton work.

name: Neonatology
fact: Its doctors work in the neonatal intensive care units.

name: Podiatry
fact: The professional is known as a podiatrist.

name: Reproductive medicine
fact: It covers a wide range of conditions, their prevention, their assessment and their treatment.

name: Obstetrics
fact: In some countries it is joined with gynaecology into one surgical discipline.

name: Rheumatology
fact: It covers more than a hundred different diseases.

name: Sports medicine
fact: Teams have had their own physicians for a long time, but the field itself is recent.

name: Traumatology
fact: It is a branch of medicine, and in practice it never sleeps.

name: Health education
fact: It takes in the health of the surroundings, of the body, of the mind and of the life between people.

name: Infant mortality
fact: It is counted as deaths per thousand live births, and it is the plainest measure a country has of itself.

name: Maternal death
fact: Different health organisations define it in slightly different ways.

name: Chiropractic
fact: Its main technique is manual, and it may be joined to exercise and advice.

name: Medicinal plants
fact: Plants make hundreds of compounds to defend themselves, and we have been borrowing them ever since.

name: Homeopathy
fact: Samuel Hahnemann conceived it at the end of the eighteenth century.

name: Naturopathy
fact: A wide array of practices branded as natural or as self healing are used by its practitioners.

name: Osteopathy
fact: In most countries its practitioners are not medically trained.

name: African traditional medicine
fact: Diviners, midwives and herbalists all have their place in it.

name: Ancient Egyptian medicine
fact: Simple surgery, the setting of bones, dentistry and a long list of remedies were all part of it.

name: Ancient Greek medicine
fact: The Greek word for medicine gave us the words we still use for the healing art.

name: Folk healer
fact: In many places they were, and are, the only help within reach.

name: Humorism
fact: It began to fall out of favour in the seventeenth century and was finally undone by the discovery of microbes.

name: Bloodletting
fact: It rested on the belief that the fluids of the body had to be kept in balance, and it outlived every argument against it.

name: Medicine in the medieval Islamic world
fact: It took in the medical knowledge of classical antiquity, set it in order, and carried it forward.

name: Chinese herbology
fact: It is one of several great traditions of materia medica.

name: Tui na
fact: As a branch of traditional Chinese medicine it is often used alongside acupuncture, cupping, herbalism and the internal martial arts.

name: Medical procedure
fact: One done only to find out what is wrong is called a medical test.

name: General anaesthesia
fact: It is achieved with medications that can be injected or inhaled, often with a painkiller and a muscle relaxant.

name: Local anaesthesia
fact: It lets patients undergo surgical and dental procedures with less pain and distress.

name: End of life care
fact: It can be given in the hours, days or months before a person dies.

name: Hospice
fact: It puts comfort and quality of life ahead of cure.

name: In vitro fertilisation
fact: Eggs are taken from the ovaries and fertilised in a culture medium in a laboratory.

name: Surrogacy
fact: People pursue it for reasons such as infertility or the dangers of pregnancy.

name: Screening
fact: It aims to find a condition early enough for earlier intervention.

name: Auscultation
fact: It is used to examine the circulatory and respiratory systems and the gut.

name: Heart sounds
fact: They reflect the turbulence created when the heart valves snap shut.

name: Respiratory sounds
fact: A stethoscope placed over the lung fields makes them easy to hear.

name: Blood culture
fact: Healthy blood holds no microorganisms, so their presence can point to a bloodstream infection.

name: Complete blood count
fact: It counts white blood cells, red blood cells and platelets.

name: Glucose test
fact: Eating food leads to elevated blood sugar levels.

name: Lipid profile
fact: The results can show risk of cardiovascular disease.

name: Diagnostic microbiology
fact: Since the discovery of the germ theory of disease, scientists have been finding ways to grow specific organisms.

name: Palpation
fact: It means feeling an object in or on the body to judge its size, shape, firmness or location.

name: Telehealth
fact: It includes data sharing by way of patient portals and electronic medical records.

name: Urine test
fact: Urine reflects the working of many body systems, particularly the kidneys, and it is easy to obtain.

name: Drug test
fact: It is also called a toxicology screen.

name: Pregnancy test
fact: The two main methods are testing blood or urine for the pregnancy hormone and scanning with ultrasound.

name: Vital signs
fact: They help assess general health, give clues to possible diseases and show progress toward recovery.

name: Human body temperature
fact: It varies from person to person and across the day.

name: Respiratory rate
fact: It is usually measured in breaths per minute.

name: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation
fact: It is recommended for anyone who is unresponsive with no breathing or abnormal breathing.

name: Cauterisation
fact: It destroys some tissue to limit bleeding and damage or to remove an undesired growth.

name: Heimlich manoeuvre
fact: It is named for the American doctor Henry Heimlich.

name: Haemodialysis
fact: It removes waste products and excess water from the blood outside the body.

name: Massage
fact: It is commonly applied with hands, fingers, elbows, knees, forearms, feet or a device.

name: Occupational therapy
fact: These include self care tasks, work, school, social participation and leisure.

name: Oxygen therapy
fact: It can also mean the use of oxygen enriched air at altitude.

name: Phage therapy
fact: It emerged early in the twentieth century but was largely replaced by antibiotics after the Second World War.

name: Stem cell therapy
fact: The best established form is the transplantation of blood forming stem cells.

name: Tracheal intubation
fact: The trachea is also called the windpipe.

name: Dental braces
fact: They are often used to correct underbites, overbites, open bites and gaps.

name: Dental extraction
fact: It is most commonly done to remove teeth that have become unrestorable through decay.

name: Dental implant
fact: It rests on a biological process called osseointegration.

name: Angioplasty
fact: A deflated balloon on a catheter is passed over a guide wire to the narrowing and inflated.

name: Caesarean section
fact: It is often performed because vaginal delivery would put the mother or child at risk.

name: Coronary artery bypass surgery
fact: It can relieve chest pain and slow the progression of the disease.

name: Debridement
fact: Removal may be surgical, mechanical, chemical or by maggot therapy.

name: Hysterectomy
fact: When the uterus is removed and the cervix spared it is called supracervical.

name: Laser eye surgery
fact: An ophthalmologist uses a laser or a microkeratome to create a corneal flap.

name: Neurosurgery
fact: That includes the brain, spinal cord, peripheral nerves and the blood vessels of the brain.

name: Heart transplantation
fact: The most common procedure takes a functioning heart from a recently deceased organ donor.

name: Kidney transplantation
fact: It is classed as deceased donor or living donor depending on the source of the organ.

name: Pharmacotherapy
fact: Drugs given to prevent illness are called prophylaxis.

name: Adverse effect
fact: When judged to be secondary to the main effect it may be called a side effect.

name: Drug class
fact: Several systems of classification exist.

name: Drug interaction
fact: A popular example is the effect of grapefruit on the metabolism of drugs.

name: Psychoactive drug
fact: It is also called a mind altering or psychotropic substance.

name: Depressant
fact: They are colloquially known as downers.

name: Hallucinogen
fact: Historically they have also been called entheogens.

name: Sedative
fact: Sedatives are central nervous system depressants that slow brain activity.

name: Drug discovery
fact: Historically, drugs were found by isolating the active ingredient from traditional remedies or by chance, as with penicillin.

name: Side effect
fact: These effects are often adverse but sometimes beneficial.

name: Drug delivery
fact: It covers drug preparation, route of administration, site specific targeting, metabolism and toxicity.

name: Dosage form
fact: They contain a mixture of active ingredients and inactive components, shaped in a particular way such as a capsule shell, and apportioned into a specific dose.

name: Intravenous therapy
fact: It is commonly used for rehydration or to feed those who cannot eat.

name: Oral administration
fact: It is a common route for many medications.

name: Topical medication
fact: Most often it goes onto the skin or mucous membranes as creams, foams, gels, lotions or ointments.

name: Anticoagulant
fact: Some occur naturally in blood eating animals such as leeches and mosquitoes.

name: Anticonvulsant
fact: Many are also used to treat bipolar disorder because they act as mood stabilizers.

name: Antidote
fact: The word comes from a Greek phrase meaning a medicine given as a remedy.

name: Bronchodilator
fact: Some are made naturally in the body and others are medications.

name: Diabetes medication
fact: The choice depends on the type of diabetes and the situation of the person.

name: Hormone replacement therapy
fact: Those effects include hot flashes, accelerated skin aging and decreased muscle mass.

name: Immunosuppressive drug
fact: They are given to stop the body rejecting a transplanted organ.

name: Statin
fact: They are typically prescribed to people who are at high risk of cardiovascular disease.

name: Antihistamine
fact: They give relief from nasal congestion, sneezing or hives caused by pollen and other allergens.

name: Antimicrobial
fact: Antimicrobial medicines can be grouped according to the microorganisms they are used to treat.

name: Amoxicillin
fact: It treats ear infections, strep throat, pneumonia, skin infections and urinary tract infections.

name: Doxycycline
fact: It is used against pneumonia, acne, Lyme disease, cholera and syphilis.

name: Aciclovir
fact: It is primarily used for the treatment of herpes simplex virus infections, chickenpox and shingles.

name: Fluconazole
fact: These include candidiasis, cryptococcosis and ringworm.

name: Antiparasitic
fact: They work by destroying the parasite or inhibiting its growth.

name: Nonsteroidal anti inflammatory drug
fact: Side effects include a risk of stomach ulcers and bleeds.

name: Opioid
fact: They work on opioid receptors in the brain and other organs to produce morphine like effects, including pain relief.

name: Codeine
fact: The body converts it to morphine.

name: Fentanyl
fact: It is many times more potent than morphine.

name: Methadone
fact: Prescribed for daily use, it relieves cravings and opioid withdrawal symptoms.

name: Anxiolytic
fact: It is the opposite of an agent that increases anxiety.

name: Antipsychotic
